title: Software Engineer, DevAI
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
Our mission is to make every Airbnb engineer's day better by building world-class developer infrastructure that removes friction and provides the tools to unlock their best work. The Dev AI team specifically builds the foundational AI tooling and infrastructure that powers developer productivity across the entire software development lifecycle, also providing the building blocks for teams across the company to quickly and simply create their own domain-specific AI tools. We currently serve as both a platform team and an internal AI consultancy for partner teams building their own internally-facing AI-powered solutions.
In this role, you will help to shape and execute the technical direction of the team's infrastructure and products. You'll work across a range of exciting problem spaces, from agentic coding tools and asynchronous AI workflow platforms, to SDKs for rapid internal AI app development and AI-assisted code migration. At Airbnb, you won't just build AI tools; your work will shape how individuals across the company work every day. The tools you create will directly accelerate the pace of innovation across our entire product surface.
We're a collaborative, low-ego, and highly-visible team that values experimentation, learning, and shipping. We celebrate what works and learn quickly from what doesn't. Given the rapid evolution of AI, we strive to operate with startup-like agility, iterating swiftly to evaluate and incorporate the most recent AI technologies into our developer tooling. If you enjoy building, collaborating across teams, thrive when given high autonomy, and are motivated to make the lives of other developers easier and more enjoyable, we’d love to hear from you.
A Typical Day:
• Help shape and drive our AI for Developers strategy, from ideation through shipping, while bringing strong sense of ownership and coding across various stacks
• Make pragmatic architectural and technical decisions, balancing ambition with real-world constraints and long-term operability
• Stay current on the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape, and help the team balance innovation with incremental, measurable developer impact
• Serve as a champion, expert, coach, and consultant to empower teams and leaders across the company to adopt and leverage new AI capabilities in their day to day workflows
• Champion engineering excellence through high-quality code, thoughtful design, and reliable systems
• Participate in on-call rotations and drive operational excellence for the team's platform components
Your Expertise:
• 2+ years industry experience (or equivalent depth of expertise)
• Prior experience building developer infrastructure, tooling, or platforms, ideally at scale and with tools, frameworks, or systems commonly used in the industry
• Hands-on experience applying AI technologies to real-world software development challenges
• A track record of quickly ramping up in new domains, technologies, or languages — and a genuine excitement for continuous learning
• Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally, with excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Proficiency in one or more of Go, Python, Typescript, or Kotlin
• Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree or equivalent experience
Your Location:
This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.
Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.
We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.
Equal Employment Opportunity:
Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.
How We'll Take Care of You:
Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
Pay Range
$162,000—$190,000 USD
Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Developer Relations, Platform
description:
## About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
## About the role
As a member of Platform Developer Relations at Anthropic, you'll shape how developers discover, onboard, build, and scale applications and agents on the Claude Platform. You'll build with our APIs, teach developers how to get the most out of them, and bring what you learn back to the teams building our products.
This role sits within our platform engineering organization. You'll work across content, community, and product influence, and partner closely with product managers, engineers, communications, and marketing. Your audience ranges from independent developers working on side projects to platform teams at large enterprises.
The relationships you build between developers and our internal teams will help us advance our mission of creating reliable, interpretable AI that follows human intent.
## Key responsibilities
• Create high-quality technical content, including demos, sample apps, tutorials, videos, and integration guides, that shows developers how to build effectively on the Claude Platform
• Tailor content to individual developers and enterprise builders, choosing formats and channels that work for each
• Contribute directly to the developer experience of the Claude Platform, including our docs, code samples, cookbooks, and open source skills like the Claude API skill
• Make our docs, SDKs, and samples work well for both developers and the coding agents they build with, and keep them accurate as our APIs change
• Partner with product and engineering on launches from early feedback through release day, with docs, samples, and migration guidance ready when we ship
• Translate developer feedback into clear recommendations, and get involved early enough to influence API and product decisions
• Find pain points in our APIs, SDKs, docs, and agent tooling, and work with engineering to get them fixed, including shipping directly yourself when it makes sense
• Be a voice developers trust, and engage directly and thoughtfully with their questions and criticism
• Build and grow developer communities online and in person through events, workshops, and the places developers already gather
• Partner with communications, marketing, and GTM teams on launches, campaigns, and events, and advocate for messaging that is useful and credible to developers
• Collaborate with research to translate new AI capabilities into accessible educational resources
• Prioritize your work based on data, developer feedback, and business needs, and measure its impact
## Minimum qualifications
• You have significant experience in developer relations, developer experience, or developer-facing product or engineering roles, with a track record of measurably improving how developers adopt or use a platform
• You have hands-on technical abilities: you've recently built with LLM APIs, can write and explain your own demos, and know what makes a code sample reliable and easy to adapt
• You have informed opinions about AI platforms and developer tooling, including what works well and what needs to improve
• You've created technical content that developers use, and you can explain complex ideas to audiences ranging from individual developers to enterprise technical leaders
• You've used developer feedback to influence product or engineering decisions, including ones that were difficult to advocate for
• You collaborate well across engineering, product, communications, and marketing, can disagree constructively, and take ownership of communicating a decision once it's made
• You're passionate about AI's potential and committed to developing it responsibly, with a genuine interest in AI safety
## Preferred qualifications
• Experience building agents, including work with tool use, MCP, evals, or managed agent runtimes
• Experience growing a developer community and building trust with skeptical audiences
• Experience supporting both individual developers and enterprise platform teams
• Experience using Claude or other AI tools in your own developer relations or engineering work
• A scrappy, autonomous working style as a low-ego, kind, and direct collaborator with a bias toward shipping
• Public speaking experience at industry conferences and events
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.
For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
Annual Salary:
$365,000—$435,000 USD
## Logistics
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
## How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
## Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer, DotCom
description:
About the Team

DotCom builds the web experiences that introduce OpenAI’s research and products to the world. We bring together engineering, design, content, and production to make complex technology clear, useful, and engaging. Our work spans OpenAI.com https://openai.com/, product storytelling such as the ChatGPT overview https://chatgpt.com/overview/, and interactive experiences such as OpenAI Progress https://progress.openai.com/.

For businesses exploring AI, these experiences help connect new capabilities to real needs. We partner with product and marketing teams to show what OpenAI’s products can do and help people discover how to use them. The work combines visual craft with the engineering behind fast, accessible experiences that reach a global audience.

About the Role

We’re hiring a software engineer to take dedicated ownership of B2B web experiences on DotCom. You’ll work directly with product teams to understand their capabilities, then partner with design and marketing to bring those capabilities and stories to life on OpenAI.com https://openai.com/ through product pages, interactive features, and discovery experiences.

This is a frontend-focused role for an engineer who combines strong UI skills with product judgment and can connect the interface to the systems behind it. You’ll shape ambiguous projects, make thoughtful technical and design tradeoffs, and own delivery from the first prototype through launch and iteration. We welcome frontend and full-stack backgrounds with a strong track record of building for the web.

This role is based on-site in San Francisco or New York City.

In this role, you will:

 - Build and evolve B2B product pages and interactive web experiences that help business audiences understand OpenAI’s capabilities and discover relevant products and use cases.

 - Partner with product engineers to bring capabilities, integrations, and directory-style discovery experiences onto OpenAI.com https://openai.com/, connecting user-facing interfaces with the APIs and data they need.

 - Develop reusable UI components and patterns with designers, balancing visual detail, accessibility, responsiveness, and maintainability.

 - Use analytics, feature flags, and experiments to understand user behavior and improve discovery, engagement, and conversion.

 - Improve performance, reliability, and localization support so experiences work well across devices, languages, and periods of high traffic.

 - Drive projects across product, design, marketing, and content partners: clarify goals, question assumptions, resolve dependencies, and carry work through launch and ongoing improvement.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - 7+ years of frontend and/or full-stack software development experience, with an emphasis on building polished web products and integrating APIs.

 - Strong frontend fundamentals in JavaScript, CSS, and browser behavior, with experience building and evolving reusable component systems.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across product, design, marketing, and engineering teams.

 - Deep care for quality, functionality, and the people using your work, with attention to every detail—from visual interactions and accessibility to the last page request.

 - Innate curiosity and strong product judgment: you ask critical questions, challenge assumptions, and turn complex ideas into clear, useful experiences.

 - Enjoyment of working quickly, with the initiative to navigate ambiguity, unblock collaborators, and own projects from prototype through launch and iteration.

 - Experience with B2B products, web growth, experimentation, or conversion optimization is a plus.

 - Experience with React or Next.js, or with high-traffic, localized websites, is helpful; strong web fundamentals and the ability to learn matter most.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: AI Voice Recording Contributor - Mandarin Chinese (Hong Kong)
description:
We are looking for AIVoice Recording Contributors to join a Mandarin Chinese voice evaluation project and help support the development of the next generation of AI technologies.
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)
Project Duration: Approximately 1 month
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 18 USD/hour
## Help Shape the Future of AI
This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.
You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents.
## How Your Recordings Will Be Used
Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.
## What You’ll Do
• Read provided text cards aloud and record them exactly as written (there approximately 640 cards per person).
• Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided.
• Speak using your natural dialect and accent.
• Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered.
• Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards.
• Complete tasks using our internal recording platform.
## What We’re Looking For
Native-level fluency in Mandarin Chinese.
• Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use.
• Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.
• Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent.
• Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own.
• Experience with speech recording projects is an advantage, but not required.
• Strong communication skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain recording accuracy.
## Technical Requirements
• Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.
• Computer microphone or headset with microphone.
• Reliable internet connection.
• Ability to access and use an online recording platform.
## What We Offer
• Flexible, remote work.
• Timely and reliable payments.
• Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.
• Access to future language and AI-related projects.
• A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.
## Vendor Type
When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.
## Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?
A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to a registered business in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. title: Cloud and Observability Engineer (Remote Role, 6pm - 3am)
description:
## Description
Coralogix is a modern, full-stack observability platform transforming how businesses process and understand their data. Our unique architecture powers in-stream analytics without reliance on expensive indexing or hot storage. We specialize in comprehensive monitoring of logs, metrics, trace and security events with features such as APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes monitoring and more, all enhancing operational efficiency and reducing observability spend by up to 70%.
Coralogix is rebuilding the path to observability using a real-time streaming analytics pipeline that provides monitoring, visualization, and alerting capabilities without the burden of indexing.
By enabling users to define different data pipelines per use case, we provide deep Observability and Security insights, at an infinite scale, for less than half the cost.
﻿What you’ll do
Work closely with customers and Coralogix TAMs to understand existing monitoring setups (Grafana, Splunk, New Relic, DataDog etc.) and recreate, improve, and automate alerts and dashboards in Coralogix.
Key Responsibilities
1. Observability Implementation
• Understand customer use cases (alerts, dashboards, log parsing) from existing platforms
• Rebuild and optimize them in Coralogix
• Ensure accuracy, consistency, and best practices
2. Alert & Dashboard Creation
• Design alerts and dashboards based on real-world use cases
• Work with metrics, logs, and queries (PromQL, Dataprime, Lucene)
• Improve monitoring quality and reduce noise
3. Migration & Conversion {Key Deliverable}
• Migrate alerts, dashboards, and parsing rules from tools like Datadog, Splunk, etc.
• Translate queries and logic into Coralogix-compatible formats
4. Automation (Key Focus Area)
• Build scripts/tools to automate alert and dashboard conversion
• Standardize and scale migration processes
• Reduce manual effort through reusable frameworks

title: Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d)
description:
Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d)
Remote in Germany, Austria, Spain, Portugal, Italy, the Netherlands or the UK · Full-time · Engineering, Interoperability team
About Recare
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.
What to expect as our Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):
Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.
Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.
Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.
Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.
Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.
In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):
Hospital staff still spend hours typing the same patient data into different systems. Our in-house RPA tool ends that: it automates hospital information systems (HIS) on Windows desktops so our data lands in patient forms automatically. We don't use UiPath or Blue Prism. We build our own engine in TypeScript, on Electron and Node with native Windows bindings.
You'll join the Interoperability team as a hands-on engineer. Your main focus is the engine itself; everything else builds on it.
You build, extend and stabilize the core of our RPA engine.
You make automations reliable in hospital environments we don't fully control, with remote updates and failure monitoring.
You automate HIS applications on Windows, including the hard legacy cases: UI Automation, Java Access Bridge, SAP GUI Scripting or the browser where the app runs locally.
You solve the Citrix problem. Most hospitals serve their HIS through Citrix, where all we see is pixels, so you work with OCR, image anchors, mouse and keyboard input, and the redraw, scrolling and display-scaling issues that come with them.
You help extend the engine with new capabilities such as document extraction and voice input.
You set up the rollout process with our implementation team: installers, code signing and autostart in locked-down hospital IT, and fixing problems on machines you can't log into.
You protect health data by applying security best practices and complying with privacy regulations.
## Requirements
Here's how we picture you as our Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):
You have 5+ years of relevant industry experience and have built automation software that runs in production, not only configured bots in an RPA product.
## You write strong TypeScript or similar
You have automated Windows desktop applications with UI Automation, plus at least one of Java Access Bridge, SAP GUI Scripting or browser automation over CDP, and native interop (Node native addons, C# or C++).
You have experience with image-based automation over Citrix or RDP (OCR, screen anchors), or a strong wish to learn it. UiPath or Blue Prism developers with Citrix or computer-vision experience who now want to build the engine are very welcome.
You know how to keep automations reliable in production: monitoring, failure handling, updates, and testing against apps you can't run in CI.
You communicate clearly in English with technical and non-technical people, and you're comfortable working with German-language software.
You analyze problems thoroughly and drive them to resolution.
Nice to have: experience with OCR, document extraction or speech-to-text; healthcare or HIS integration experience; knowledge of GDPR and sensitive data; spoken German, which helps during rollout with hospital IT.
Not a perfect match on every point? We care more about shared drive and a real sense of mission than about ticking every box.
If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Collections AI & Operations Intern
description:
At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs’ potential by providing financial solutions tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America, where SMBs’ financial needs are met without ever having to go to a bank.
R2 enables platforms across Latin America to embed financial services that SMBs can leverage, starting with revenue-based financing. We are a high-performing, close-knit team with talent from organizations such as Google, Amazon, Nubank, Uber, Capital One, Mercado Libre, Globant, and J.P. Morgan.
We are entering a new phase of growth following a strategic investment from Ant International, focused on rapidly expanding our partner footprint, strengthening our credit and underwriting capabilities, and scaling operations across multiple markets.
As a Collections AI & Operations Intern, you will make sure every interaction with our customers is accurate, truthful and high quality, and support the team’s day-to-day operations. In Collections, we talk with businesses that have fallen behind on their loans to help them get back on track, and we do it with our own AI agents that speak with thousands of customers every month. Our model: AI for volume, people for value. You will work with the Collections team, report directly to the Collections Lead, and interact with partners and teams in different countries. The role will grow with you: as you progress, you will take on new responsibilities.
## What you’ll work on
## AI Quality
• Design, implement and fine-tune tools that check that our AI agents give correct information, follow the negotiation flow and escalate when they should.
* Grade conversations by hand to confirm that the AI evaluates them the same way a person would.
* Create new categories to classify conversations, such as signs of customer frustration or suspected identity fraud.
## Monitoring & Customer Support
• Monitor agent performance against targets and catch problems early.
* Review cases the AI escalates to our team, confirm they need human attention, and identify errors such as duplicate tickets.
## * Respond to customer tickets.
## Operations
• Apply payments and keep loan information up to date.
* Update our partners’ email and SMS communications.
* Document what you build so the team can run it on its own.
* Part of the job is reviewing many conversations with focus and consistency; the quality of everything else depends on it.
## Who you are
• Student pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commercial Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
* At least 6 months of experience in a similar role (internship or job) in tech, fintech, financial services, customer service or operations.
* Excellent written Spanish: you will write instructions and messages read by thousands of people.
* Upper-intermediate English, to read documentation and write instructions for AI tools.
* Attention to detail and accuracy with numbers: you notice when something doesn’t add up, even if it’s small.
* Curious about AI: you use it in your daily life and want to understand how it works under the hood.
## What makes you stand out
• Being in the final years of your degree.
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.
* Experience in collections, customer service, communications or finance.
* Your own ideas to improve processes: when you see something that could work better, you propose how.
## What you’ll gain
• In three months, you will go from not knowing how an AI is evaluated to building the tools that do it, in a real operation serving customers in several countries.
* Real responsibility from your first week, alongside a team that will teach you.
Location: Remote (Mexico, Colombia, Chile or Peru)
## Department: Collections
## Contract type: 3-month internship

title: Data Analyst - Commercial
description:
## Role and Responsibilities
• Coordinate the collection, extraction, cleansing and validation of commercial data across Ergomed, PrimeVigilance and ADAMAS, working with business data owners to resolve discrepancies and ensure reliable reporting inputs.
• Prepare and deliver weekly commercial reports to agreed deadlines, highlighting key movements, trends, exceptions and areas requiring leadership attention at Group, business and regional levels.
• Prepare and maintain standard monthly commercial reporting packs, combining validated metrics, performance against agreed targets, trend and variance analysis across all three businesses.
• Design, build and maintain Microsoft Power BI data models, dashboards and reports, providing consistent Group-level views and business-specific drill-downs with appropriate access controls and reliable refresh processes.
• Analyse commercial performance, including pipeline, business wins, conversion rates and performance against targets, to identify trends, explain variances and provide decision-useful insights, clearly distinguishing findings from assumptions.
• Partner with global and regional stakeholders to define reporting requirements, agree priorities and translate business questions into practical analytical outputs, balancing common reporting standards with the needs of each business.
• Create executive-ready reporting and presentations in PowerPoint using think-cell, translating complex datasets into clear charts, concise narratives and consistent visual formats for leadership reviews.
• Support market, customer and competitive analysis through targeted secondary research and available data, prioritising activities that inform commercial reporting and leadership decisions across the three businesses.
• Maintain common KPI definitions, reporting documentation, data mappings, version control and quality checks; reconcile outputs with approved source data and document business-specific differences to support consistent, traceable reporting.
• Deliver ad hoc analysis in response to leadership and business requests, clarifying the question, scope and deadline and communicating findings, assumptions and limitations clearly without compromising scheduled reporting commitments.
• Work collaboratively across Business Development, Marketing, Finance, Operations and relevant systems teams across businesses and regions to align reporting inputs, validate interpretation and support adoption of reporting tools.
• Drive the agreed modernisation of existing reporting, moving manual and fragmented outputs towards scalable Power BI dashboards, automated data preparation and reusable executive reporting templates; test and validate changes before transition and document improvements.
• Follow applicable requirements for data access, confidentiality, data protection and appropriate data use.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent relevant practical experience in data analytics, reporting or business intelligence.
Approximately 2–4 years of relevant experience in commercial data analysis, reporting or business intelligence, including hands-on development of Power BI dashboards and preparation of recurring management reports.
Experience producing executive reporting and presentations using PowerPoint and think-cell. Experience supporting stakeholders across multiple businesses, regions or functions and improving manual reporting processes. Experience in life sciences or a professional services environment is desirable.
When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.
We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.
Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.
The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

title: Software Engineer (Mid-level)

Are you a C# engineer who enjoys building reliable, high-performance software and is excited about the possibilities of AI?
We’re looking for a Software Engineer II – AI & C# to join our team and help build and enhance PDI’s market-leading POS and back-office solutions. This role is a great opportunity for an experienced software engineer who has strong C#/.NET fundamentals and wants to expand their hands-on experience with artificial intelligence.
You do not need prior production AI experience. We’re looking for solid engineering skills, curiosity, and a desire to learn.
You’ll work as part of an agile engineering team designing, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise software while helping introduce practical AI capabilities into our products. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, architects, product owners, UX, QA, SRE, and operations to deliver scalable solutions that solve real business problems.
## What You'll Do

• Support AI quality and safety: Develop test cases, evaluate AI outputs, and help identify accuracy, privacy, security, and payment-data considerations before solutions reach customers.
• Use AI to engineer smarter: Leverage AI coding assistants responsibly to improve development productivity and code quality while sharing effective practices with the broader team.
• Collaborate across teams: Partner with Product, UX, Architecture, QA, SRE, and Operations to translate retail and fuel workflows into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.
• Own your work: Take features from design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
• Mentor others: Support junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.Contribute to the Agile team: Participate in Scrum ceremonies, planning, estimation, and continuous improvement efforts.
• Keep learning: Stay current with evolving development frameworks, cloud technologies, and AI tools and apply what you learn to real customer problems.
## What We're Looking For
• 3+ years of software development experience in a software product development environment.
• Strong hands-on experience with C# and .NET, including ASP.NET Core and Web APIs.
• Working knowledge of SQL, preferably SQL Server.
• Exposure to AI/ML concepts through professional experience, coursework, certifications, or personal projects.
• Some experience experimenting with technologies such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or other LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or generative AI tools. Production AI experience is not required.
• Experience with Git, Postman, Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar development tools.
• Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile development practices.
• Familiarity with at least one public cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.Comfortable working in both Windows and Linux environments, including PowerShell and bash.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to work through complex technical challenges.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills and a willingness to collaborate, mentor, and share knowledge.
• A self-motivated, curious mindset with the ability to learn new technologies quickly and deliver in a fast-paced environment.
## Nice to Have
Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:
• Angular or other modern JavaScript frameworks
• Python
• Delphi
• Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
• Embeddings and vector databases
• AI evaluation or testing frameworks
• Retail or convenience-store technology
• Point-of-sale (POS) systems
• Payments, EMV, or PCI environments
• Forecourt/fuel systems
• Wholesale or logistics technologies
This is an opportunity to build on your existing software engineering experience while developing skills in one of the fastest-moving areas of technology. You’ll have the chance to experiment with AI, learn from experienced engineers and architects, and turn new ideas into features that solve real problems for PDI customers.
You don’t need to come in as an AI expert. Bring your C#/.NET expertise, engineering mindset, and curiosity. We’ll give you the opportunity to grow the rest.
PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.

It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API.

This role sits at the intersection of data and operations. You’ll translate business questions into analysis, and analysis into process improvements. Because we’re in the middle of an integration, you’ll often work with data from different systems and help bring structure where it’s still evolving. That’s a real challenge, and also a great opportunity to shape how revenue data works across the company.

Revenue process optimization

• Evaluate Salesforce functionality and recommend improvements to how we use it.

Collaboration & support
• Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to turn business needs into data insights.
• Support users with CRM reporting questions and troubleshooting.
• Help train teams on data best practices and reporting tools.
## What we’re looking for
• 2+ years of experience in data analysis, revenue analytics, or CRM optimization.
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Proficiency in SQL and Excel/Google Sheets.
• Hands-on experience with Salesforce and with tools such as Metabase, Snowflake, or similar BI/data platforms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.
• Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• A detail-oriented, proactive approach: you spot issues, dig into them, and resolve them independently.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Fluent English, written and spoken.
## Nice to have
• Experience in digital marketplaces or B2B e-commerce, including inventory, pricing, and price list management.
• A track record of using AI or automation to drive efficiencies in data or revenue processes.
• Background in commercial or operations strategy, with measurable impact on revenue growth.
## What We Offer
• An independent, flexible, and versatile role within a fast-growing international organization.
• Flexible, remote working environment.
• We encourage continuous learning and professional growth.
## Why Join Koronet
• Global and Remote-First: Work with a diverse team across the Americas and Europe, with flexibility to work from anywhere.
• Ownership Culture: We foster an environment where each team member takes ownership and is empowered to contribute to the company's success.
• Growth & Development: We support continuous professional growth and offer financial assistance for technical certifications and other learning opportunities.
• Compensation: Competitive, negotiable based on experience.
If you're passionate about making an impact and growing with a dynamic, remote-first company, we want to hear from you!

title: Data Analyst
description:
This is a remote position.
Join one of the Philippines' fastest-growing tech companies! Open to Philippine-based candidates only.
About the Role
As a Data Analyst, you will support our client's Microsoft Fabric data warehouse project by helping the team understand source data, define how it should be structured, and map it accurately into the target warehouse.
This is a hands-on, mid-level role focused on data profiling, SQL analysis, table design, and source-to-target mapping. You will work on a defined set of project deliverables, follow the team's technical direction, and independently manage your assigned analysis tasks.
We're looking for someone who combines practical data analysis skills with attention to detail and clear communication. You should be comfortable investigating unfamiliar datasets, documenting findings, and working with the project team to resolve data questions. The role requires overlap with US Central business hours; the specific schedule and required overlap will be confirmed during the hiring process.
Key Responsibilities
Data Profiling: Examine source datasets to understand their structure, completeness, consistency, relationships, and potential data quality issues.
SQL Analysis: Write and troubleshoot SQL queries to explore data, investigate discrepancies, and support warehouse requirements.
Table Design: Help define warehouse tables, including columns, data types, keys, and relationships, in line with the project's design direction.
Source-to-Target Mapping: Create and maintain mappings that describe how source fields should populate target tables, including transformation rules and business logic.
Requirements Clarification: Work with stakeholders and technical team members to clarify data definitions, business rules, and expected outputs.
Data Validation: Use SQL and reconciliation checks to confirm that proposed mappings and transformations produce the expected results.
Documentation: Maintain clear profiling findings, mapping specifications, table definitions, and records of unresolved data questions.
Independent Delivery: Take ownership of assigned analysis tasks, communicate progress, flag blockers early, and follow agreed project standards.
Team Collaboration:Partner with data engineers and other project stakeholders to support delivery of the Microsoft Fabric data warehouse.
## Requirements
• Mid-level, hands-on experience in data analysis, with relevant work supporting data warehouses or data integration projects.
• Strong SQL skills for querying, joining, aggregating, and investigating data across multiple tables.
• Practical experience profiling source data and identifying data quality issues.
• Experience contributing to table design, including data types, keys, and relationships.
• Experience creating source-to-target mappings and documenting transformation rules.
• Understanding of data warehouse concepts and ETL/ELT processes.
• Ability to translate data findings and business rules into clear, usable documentation.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Ability to follow technical direction while independently delivering assigned work.
• Based in the Philippines and able to work remotely with overlap during US Central business hours, subject to the agreed schedule.
• Experience with Microsoft Fabric is a plus. Relevant experience with Azure data platforms, Azure Synapse, or comparable data warehouse environments is also beneficial.
## Benefits
About Us
Full Scale is a fully remote-first company that helps businesses build dedicated teams of skilled software engineers. We make it easier for growing companies to find, onboard, and retain high-performing software talent.
Why work for us:
• 100% remote work setup.
• Work from anywhere in the Philippines.
• Opportunity to contribute to a Microsoft Fabric data warehouse project.
• Hands-on work across data profiling, SQL analysis, table design, and data mapping.
• Collaboration with data engineers and project stakeholders.
• Opportunity to deepen practical experience in modern data warehouse delivery.

title: AI Strategist
description:
## About Smartcat
Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.
We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.
Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.
Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with strong year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.
Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.
## WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM
This role is ideal for someone who loves AI, thinks in systems, and enjoys building practical solutions that drive measurable impact. You’ll be one of our first AI Strategists, building custom AI solutions from scratch for Smartcat’s largest strategic customers. You’ll work in a pod with a dedicated Strategic Account Executive and Technical Account Manager, and sometimes a Forward Deployed Engineer. You don’t need to be a software engineer, but you do need real fluency with modern AI tools, fast experimentation, and a builder’s instinct. You’ll engage senior executives to define where AI creates value, then build the agents and workflows that deliver it, and bring customer insights back to Product.
## MISSION
Design and build custom AI workflows and agents from scratch for Smartcat’s strategic customers, translating each customer’s ambiguous business problems into working, scalable, measurable AI solutions that drive adoption and expand the relationship.
## OUTCOMES
• Partner with business leaders and technical teams at strategic customers to scope high-value AI use cases and align on success metrics, from the sales cycle through delivery
• Identify where AI workflows can deliver ROI, efficiency, and competitive advantage, and build the business case with the account team
• Design, build, and deploy new custom AI solutions and agents for customers, going beyond reconfiguring existing workflows
• Work with structured and unstructured customer data, including vector databases, MCP, and RAG, and build agents that combine semantic and keyword search across customer knowledge bases and content
• Own customer engagements end to end, from ideation through delivery, ensuring long-term adoption and measurable business outcomes
• Work as part of a customer pod with the Strategic Account Executive, Technical Account Manager, and Forward Deployed Engineer
• Train and empower customer teams to use and iterate on the AI workflows you build, and drive onboarding and change management so solutions become part of their day-to-day operations
• Act as the voice of the customer, surfacing needs, patterns, and insights that inform Smartcat’s product roadmap
• Contribute playbooks, reusable solution patterns, and case studies, and help drive AI-first thinking across the team
## HOW YOU’LL RAMP
## By Day 30:
• Learn Smartcat’s platform, AI agent capabilities, and the types of AI workflows customers already run
• Meet your pod partners (Strategic Account Executives, Technical Account Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers) and understand how each role contributes
• Get oriented on your assigned strategic accounts: business goals, key stakeholders, current workflows, and open opportunities
• Get set up with the team’s AI tooling and development environment
## By Day 60:
• Join customer conversations with the account team to scope AI use cases and define success metrics
• Build and test a first custom AI solution or agent for a live customer opportunity
• Document the use case, approach, and expected business impact
## By Day 90:
• Own a customer engagement from scoping through delivery, with a working solution in the customer’s hands
• Run enablement or training for the customer’s team and support their adoption
• Bring customer feedback and reusable patterns back to Product and the wider team
## WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED
• Experience in a customer-facing AI, solutions, consulting, or technical role, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise environments
• A track record of building AI-powered workflows, agents, or automations that solved real business problems, not just integrations
• An AI-first way of working: real hands-on experience with AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, Cline, or similar (“vibe coding”), used as the default way you build, test, and solve problems
• Hands-on experience building with Python, along with AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, or Cline; SQL or data analysis is a plus
• Familiarity with vector databases, MCP, RAG, and agent design
• Comfort with the command line, basic Linux administration, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
• The ability to translate ambiguous business problems into practical, scalable AI solutions, and to drive projects end to end
• Comfort engaging both technical stakeholders and senior executives, and translating between the two, with strong communication and collaboration skills
• A customer-centric mindset, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to business value
• Experience delivering solutions in complex enterprise organizations while operating comfortably in a fast-moving startup environment
• A builder mentality: bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create structure where none exists
• Experience with change management and customer enablement
• Leading cross-functional initiatives or teams is a nice to have
• Flexibility to travel for customer engagements
## Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far
Fully remote teamWe are a global team of 180+ enthusiastic people spread across 30+ countries. We have been fully remote since 2020, with some locations populated with more Smartcaters than others, such as Austin, Belgrade, and Lisbon.
Innovating a $100 Billion industrySmartcat’s innovative approach towards multilingual content taps into a $100B industry. Our platform enables enterprise end users to stop using traditional outsourcing methods, and start enjoying an easy-to-use, AI-powered SaaS, that delivers immediate high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.
High impact role enabling innovation and inclusion in organizationsYou will enjoy building with us. You will drive changes in how an old-fashioned global language industry operates while improving how hundreds of thousands of people work and millions of people exchange knowledge and ideas worldwide.
Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here.
Smartcat Culture Code: Respect and ResultsWe value every person’s background and perspective, and we hold ourselves to high standards. We communicate clearly, honestly, and directly. Everyone is welcome here, and we do not tolerate discrimination or harassment.

Como Growth Analytics Engineer, tu misión será que el dato del que dependen las decisiones sea fiable: instrumentar bien desde el principio, auditar lo que ya existe y dejar la medición preparada para experimentar. Trabajarás sobre e-commerce y producto, y con equipos que necesitan leer resultados sin dudar de los números.
Aquí no vas a trabajar solo con herramientas de terceros: tenemos plataforma propia de experimentación y un entorno de agentes con MCPs que usamos a diario para auditar y analizar.
Y no te quedarás detrás del dato, serás quien lo explique al cliente, quien defienda qué merece medirse y quien haga visible el valor del trabajo ante sus equipos de negocio.
## ¿CUÁLES SERÁN TUS CONTRIBUCIONES?
Etiquetado de eventos en GTM para GA4 y otras herramientas de analítica.
Configuraciones avanzadas en GA4 para clientes.
Diseño de exploraciones en GA4 y de los cuadros de mando que las acompañan.
Creación de informes de resultados en Data Studioy Power BI.
Ejecución de auditoría de instrumentación para cada nuevo cliente.
Diseño y liderazgo de los planes de medición y de las taxonomías de eventos entre plataformas (web, app, servidor)
Referente técnico de instrumentación de experimentos para los equipos internos y los stakeholders de los proyectos en los que participa.
Implantación y revisión del consentimiento en la medición (Consent Mode v2, CMPs) y explicación de su efecto sobre los datos.
Instrumentación y validación de experimentos: que la variante quede registrada, que el reparto de muestra sea correcto y que no haya huecos de datos entre la herramienta de test y GA4.
Conciliación de datos entre la plataforma del cliente (e-commerce, CRM o backend) y GA4: detectar discrepancias en sesiones, conversiones e ingresos, encontrar la causa y proponer el arreglo.
Interlocución directa con los equipos del cliente (marketing, producto, negocio): presentar resultados, explicar discrepancias sin tecnicismos y acordar prioridades.
Gestión de inicio a fin de la parte de medición de tus proyectos: alcance, plazos, seguimiento y comunicación de avances.
Traducir los datos en recomendaciones accionables para el cliente, no solo en informes.

## Hard skills
Tener experiencia de +3años:
Instrumentando productos digitales (e-commerce, lead generation o áreas privadas): dataLayer, eventos de funnel y de conversión, y validación de la calidad del dato.

## Creación de dashboards para clientes.
Gestión eficaz de tareas y proyectos complejos.

Contar con altas habilidades de análisis en GA4

Ser capaz de crear dashboards avanzados en Data Studio y Power BI.

Experiencia con herramientas de experimentación(VWO, Optimizely o AB Tasty) por el lado del dato: etiquetado de variantes, control de muestra y lectura de resultados.
Consent Mode v2 y CMPsy su efecto real sobre el dato: modelado, huecos de atribución y tráfico sin asignar.

Carácter autodidacta.

Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch y Adobe Target (si no los conoces, te formamos: tenemos clientes en este stack). También Amplitude, Mixpanel, Quantum Metric y herramientas similares.

description:
## About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
## The Role
We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.
This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.
## What You Will Build
Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems.
Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows.
Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence.
Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production.
Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust.
Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale.
## What We Look For
Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience.
Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools.
Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack.
Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not.
Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time.
Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus.

People who only want research projects with no production ownership.
Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.
Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.
People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.
Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This role is based in Taiwan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Taiwan office at least 3 days per week.

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

## Technical interview

## About the Role
We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on model distillation to help us push the frontier of efficient, high-performance models. You’ll work on turning large, expensive models into smaller, faster, and more deployable systems—while maintaining or improving quality.

Design and evaluate model distillation techniques (teacher–student training, self-distillation, layer-wise distillation, representation matching, etc.)
Research tradeoffs between model size, latency, memory, and accuracy
Develop novel distillation approaches for:

Long-context or specialized architectures
## Inference-constrained environments
Run large-scale experiments and ablations; analyze results rigorously
Collaborate with engineers to productionize research outcomes

Contribute to internal research notes, technical blogs, and open-source projects when appropriate

## Required
Strong background in machine learning research
Hands-on experience with model distillation or closely related topics (compression, pruning, quantization, representation learning)
Publication experience (conference or journal papers, workshop papers, or arXiv preprints)
Solid understanding of deep learning fundamentals (optimization, training dynamics, generalization)
Fluency in PyTorch (or equivalent) and research-grade experimentation
Ability to clearly communicate research ideas, results, and limitations
## Nice to Have
Experience distilling large language models
Work on efficiency-focused research (latency, memory, throughput)
Experience with long-context models or non-Transformer architectures
Open-source contributions in ML or research tooling
Prior startup or applied research experience
## Why Join Us
Real ownership over research direction at a Series A stage
Strong support for publishing and open research
Tight feedback loop between research and real-world deployment
Access to meaningful compute and production-scale problems
Small, highly technical team with deep ML and systems expertise
## Example Backgrounds
ML researchers from academia transitioning to industry
Research engineers with published work in model efficiency
PhD / Post-doc graduates or industry researchers who still want to publish

In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing the uptime of our massive footprint of Shared, Dedicated, and OpenStack-based VPS environments, alongside modern containerized applications. A core focus of this position is utilizing our unified, in-house monitoring application (powered by a Prometheus backend) to proactively track infrastructure health, interpret complex system metrics, and rapidly isolate the root cause of service degradations.
As an SRE III, you will own critical incidents, mentor junior SREs (SRE I/II) within the department, and ensure seamless monitoring visibility across legacy systems, Plesk setups, and Kubernetes clusters.
## Key Responsibilities
Proactive Infrastructure Monitoring: Utilize our in-house monitoring application to maintain constant visibility over our environments. Analyze metric trends and implement robust, symptom-based alerting thresholds across Shared, Dedicated, VPS, and Kubernetes environments to catch issues before they impact products.
3rd Level Customer issues and Infrastructure Outage Resolution: Act as the primary technical responder and diagnostic expert during critical service or product outages, performing deep-system troubleshooting under pressure.
Diverse Platform Support: Diagnose and maintain maximum uptime and performance for traditional webhosting tech stacks, Plesk control panels, and multi-tenant OpenStack VPS environments.
Proactive Problem Management: Analyze long-term metric trends using advanced PromQL to identify systemic performance bottlenecks, hardware degradations, or configuration drift, driving deep Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Internal Department Mentorship: Coach and guide SRE I and SRE II engineers within the department to elevate the team's collective diagnostic capabilities and troubleshooting workflows using our in-house monitoring application.
## Core Technical Experience
Advanced Linux Internals: Deep, low-level understanding of Linux operating systems (CPU scheduling, memory management, I/O bottlenecks, kernel logs, file systems, and network stack troubleshooting).
Applied Prometheus & PromQL Expertise: Strong proficiency as a power user of Prometheus-backed monitoring tools. Expert-level ability to write highly optimized PromQL queries for complex alerting, dashboarding, and live incident troubleshooting.
Multi-Tenant Hosting Ecosystems: Extensive hands-on experience diagnosing failures in both traditional Shared/Dedicated Linux hosting architectures and modern Plesk control panel environments.
OpenStack & Virtualization Monitoring: Practical experience monitoring and troubleshooting Virtual Private Servers (VPS) and hypervisor behavior within an OpenStack cloud environment.
Kubernetes Workload Monitoring: Proven track record of tracking the health of containerized applications, utilizing tools like Prometheus Operator or Kube-State-Metrics to isolate pod, node, or cluster-level issues.
Internet Services Stack: Expert knowledge of underlying hosting services: Web (Nginx, Apache, Varnish), DNS (Bind/PowerDNS), Mail (Postfix/Dovecot), and Databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL).
## Skill Requirements
## Mandatory Technical Skills
• Advanced Linux Systems Engineering & OS Internals (Kernel, I/O, Networking)
• Applied Prometheus monitoring (Advanced PromQL, Metric Analysis)
• OpenStack VPS infrastructure diagnostics and health management
• Kubernetes workload and container-level monitoring

## Mandatory Behavioral & Leadership Skills

Analytical Thinking: Relies heavily on deterministic data and metrics to solve architectural and server-level problems.
Team Mentorship: Strong collaborative mindset with a willingness to mentor SRE I/II peers within the department.
Clear Synthesis: Translates complex incident realities into structured technical documentation and clear, actionable feedback for platform/development teams.
## Desirable / Optional Skills
Automation & Scripting: Ability to write or modify scripts (Python, GoLang, or advanced Bash/Shell) to assist in data gathering or routine tasks is an advantage but not mandatory.
• Experience with configuration management tools (such as Chef or Ansible).
## Education and Experience Requirements
Education: B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, IT, ECE, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
Experience: 4–8 years of experience in IT operations, with a strong focus on high-scale Webhosting, Managed Service Providers (MSP), or infrastructure administration.
Direct SRE/3rd-Level Experience: Minimum of 2 years strictly in an SRE or 3rd-level infrastructure engineering role dealing with large-scale distributed systems and deep diagnostics.
## Keywords
Linux Systems Engineering, OS Internals, 3rd Level Incident Management, Outage Resolution, Prometheus Power User, PromQL, OpenStack Monitoring, Kubernetes Monitoring, Plesk Administration, Shared Hosting, Dedicated Servers, VPS Monitoring, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Nginx, Varnis

GlobalFoundries is seeking a Level 6 AI-Enabled Device Modeling Engineer with strong artificial intelligence, machine-learning, and scientific-computing skills. The engineer will independently develop and deploy AI-enabled methods that combine device physics, measured silicon data, compact-model simulations, and TCAD results to accelerate model extraction, improve predictive accuracy, and create scalable modeling workflows for CMOS, cryogenic, photonic, superconducting, and other emerging devices.

• Develop, optimize, and validate machine-learning methods for semiconductor device modeling, including parameter extraction, surrogate modeling, model calibration, inverse modeling, and prediction of device characteristics.

Work and collaborate on other projects and/or assignments as needed.

• Understanding of supervised learning, regression, neural networks, model validation, overfitting, uncertainty, and quantitative performance evaluation.
• Working knowledge of semiconductor device physics and transistor electrical behavior, with demonstrated ability to apply AI methods to scientific or engineering modeling problems.
• Experience developing reproducible workflows for structured scientific or engineering datasets, including data preparation, visualization, feature engineering, model training, validation, and performance monitoring.
• Ability to independently execute technical assignments, communicate results clearly, and collaborate across AI, device, modeling, characterization, PDK, and design teams.
• Travel - Up to 10%.
• Fluency in English - written and verbal.
## Preferred Qualifications
• Industry, research, or advanced academic experience applying AI/ML to semiconductor devices, electronic design automation, scientific machine learning, or computational physics.
• Experience with physics-informed neural networks, differentiable programming, Bayesian optimization, Gaussian processes, active learning, or uncertainty quantification.
• Exposure to compact transistor models, SPICE simulation, parameter extraction, TCAD, cryogenic device behavior, photonic devices, superconducting devices, or quantum hardware.
• Experience using experiment tracking, version control, testing, or reproducibility tools such as Git, MLflow, Weights & Biases, containers, or automated workflows.
