title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer
London (Waterloo) · Full-time · Hybrid, three days per week in the office
## Who we are
At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone.
We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective.
We’re now building the intelligence layer that will help investors understand opportunities, make better decisions and manage their portfolios. We bring together detailed knowledge of our customers’ investments, services such as mortgages, lettings and insurance, and a team that lives and breathes property.
We’re turning our property expertise into an intelligence layer that can scale. That starts with a data platform: selecting trusted sources, keeping information current and making it useful to our products and AI agents.
We’re looking for someone to own that foundation.
## The opportunity
You’ll define and build the data platform that powers GetGround’s intelligence layer. This is a hands-on role with substantial architectural ownership: choosing how we ingest, structure, curate and serve data, while improving the foundations we already have.
The scope goes beyond integrating with APIs. You’ll build ways to ingest unstructured policy updates, regulatory guidance and published documents, turning them into reliable data our intelligence layer can use.
You’ll work closely with engineering, product and our property experts to turn domain knowledge into useful data. You’ll also design for international expansion, so entering each new market builds on a shared platform.
There’s an opportunity to influence how we build our data organisation over time, including the capabilities, standards and future hires we need.
## What you’ll do
Own data as a product. Start with the decisions our customers and AI agents need to make, then work backwards to the data required. Judge success by the usefulness and reliability of what you enable.
Be opinionated about sources and quality. Work with our property experts to identify the most valuable datasets and assess their authority, coverage, freshness and limitations. Establish clear standards for what enters the platform and how conflicting information is handled.
Build ingestion beyond APIs. Develop reliable pipelines for structured datasets, external APIs, documents and published guidance. Ingest updates from sources such as HMRC and other relevant authorities, detecting changes promptly and turning them into usable, traceable data.
Make data usable by our intelligence layer. Structure and serve information so our products and AI agents can retrieve the right facts in context. Preserve source provenance, geographic scope and effective dates so consumers can distinguish current information from historical or superseded guidance.
Design for international expansion. Build shared models and ingestion patterns that accommodate differences in property markets, tax systems and regulation. When we expand geographies, we want to go at speed, without rebuilding the platform.
Own reliability throughout the lifecycle. Build monitoring, validation and recovery into ingestion, transformation, storage and serving. Know what is stale, missing or incorrect, understand the customer impact and address the root cause.
Set the technical direction and deliver it. Make clear trade-offs between immediate product needs and long-term architecture. Ship useful improvements early, document decisions and help shape the standards and future team needed to support the platform.
## What you bring
Experience owning substantial data systems. You’ve designed, built and operated production data platforms or major parts of them, and can explain the architectural decisions you made and their consequences.
Strong engineering fundamentals. You bring strong SQL, data modelling and production programming skills, with practical experience in orchestration, testing, deployment and operating reliable pipelines.
Judgment about the data itself. You can evaluate whether a source is fit for a particular use, reconcile inconsistent information and make uncertainty or gaps visible to downstream consumers.
Experience with messy external sources. You’ve handled inconsistent formats, changing schemas, incomplete records, rate limits and integration failures. You’re comfortable working beyond clean, well-documented APIs.
A product mindset. You care about the decisions your data supports. You can work with domain experts and product engineers to translate an ambiguous need into a useful data product.
Architectural ownership. You can review an existing system, establish a direction and deliver improvements incrementally. You understand access controls, privacy and the responsibilities that come with combining customer and external data.
Clear communication and initiative. You surface problems early, write down decisions and challenge assumptions constructively. You’re comfortable making progress without a fully specified ticket.
## Bonus
Experience building data foundations for AI products, including retrieval, document processing or evaluating the quality of information supplied to agents.
Experience modelling policy or regulatory information, including versioning and effective dates.
Experience with property, financial services, geospatial data or international datasets.
Familiarity with GCP, where we run our infrastructure, and experience working alongside backend engineering teams.
Experience establishing data standards or helping build a data team.
## This role isn’t for you if
You just want to keep the pipelines running. You’ll need to care about which data we use, whether it can be trusted and how it improves the decisions our products support.
You want a fully specified architecture to implement. We need someone who can assess what exists, challenge assumptions and take ownership of the technical direction.
You only want to work with clean, structured data. Important information arrives through documents, policy announcements and inconsistent external sources. Making it usable is part of the job.
You want to stay removed from the product or domain. You’ll work closely with product engineers and property experts. Understanding what the data means and how it is used is essential.
You don’t connect with how we work. Our values—No BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsessed and healthy ego—mean communicating directly, holding a high bar, seeking feedback and being willing to change your mind.
## Why join
Own a data platform central to GetGround’s next phase of product development.
Turn deep property expertise into intelligence that helps real investors.
Work on challenging problems across customer data, property information, AI and regulated services.
Shape the architecture for international expansion and help build our future data organisation.
Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
Hybrid London working, with three days per week in Waterloo.
Benefits include private health and dental cover, a learning budget, a home-office setup budget and 12 mental health days per year.

We are building for the >80% of economic activity that happens beyond the reach of screens. AI has learned from the text, images and video online, but it still lacks an accurate understanding of physical space.
That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.
In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.
Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.
About the Role
Niantic Spatial makes the physical world computable, helping people and machines collaborate safely by aligning how they understand reality. One of the fundamental problems we're helping autonomy teams and engineers overcome is the sim-to-real gap for visual-spatial understanding. We're applying our team's decades of experience encoding the world precisely as it is at Google Maps, Google Earth, and Niantic Labs to build the scalable real-to-sim stack for embodied AI.
Niantic Spatial's R&D Team in London is seeking a Research Scientist to push the frontiers of Spatial AI, advancing our Large Geospatial Model as a dedicated member of the Embodied AI group. You will invent and develop algorithms and systems that sit at the cross-section of computer vision, machine learning, AI, graphics, and robotics.
We're passionate about discovery, so we're looking for scientists who want to learn, publish, teach, and deploy every new invention.
What You'll Do
Develop New Spatial Representations - Develop new spatial representations that embodied AI can learn from, train in, and act on.
Advance Real-to-Sim Pipelines - Advance real-to-sim pipelines connecting real-world observations, 3D reconstruction, simulation, and robotic policy learning.
Solve Emerging Spatial Problems - Solve emerging problems that relate to spatial intelligence, 3D scene representation, training data, model efficiency, and interactive systems.
Take Capabilities Through to Evidence - Take new capabilities through to evidence: what changed for the policy, not only what changed in the reconstruction.
Build Prototypes - Build proof of concept prototypes, initially for internal use, where some will need to run at production scale on customer data.
Collaborate Across Research and Product - Collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and product partners to bring novel models to production.
Publish Your Work - Publish and present your work.
What You'll Bring
A PhD in computer vision, robotics, graphics, machine learning, or a related field, or equivalent research experience, with a publication record at top venues.
Substantial expertise in robotics or embodied AI, including experience in sim-to-real transfer, domain randomization, policy evaluation, and simulation-based learning.
Deep experience with 3D scene representations: Gaussian splatting, neural fields, meshes, point clouds, or implicit representations.
You have applied generative or diffusion models to 3D data, such as scene completion, inpainting, relighting, or novel view synthesis from sparse capture.
You have worked on 3D semantics, open-vocabulary scene understanding, or scene graphs.
Proficiency in Python and Deep Learning libraries such as PyTorch.
GPU or graphics programming experience, such as custom CUDA kernels, shaders, or differentiable rendering.
A track record of contributing to widely used open-source research codebases.
Nice to Have
Proficiency in C++.
Compensation & Benefits
Base salary range of £103,500 to £202,500. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.
Location & Work Model
This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office.
Inclusive Application

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it.
Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in under 200ms. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.
We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.
## How We Work: AI-First by Design
Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively uses AI tools to do their best work, from research and writing to building automated workflows. We expect every new hire to bring genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to working smarter and faster with it.
For some, this means staying open to new tools. For others, it means architecting new systems with AI at the core. We're transparent about expectations for every role, and we give you the tools and support to thrive.
## About the Team
You'll join our small central AI team. We help every function at Harmonic, from sales to legal, achieve more with AI. People closest to the work bring the ideas and prototype solutions. We provide the shared platform, standards and guardrails, and turn the ideas with the most impact into AI solutions the whole company benefits from.
## About the Role
At Harmonic we use AI to help us operate more effectively and scale as a business. You’ll take what works for one person and make it work for everyone: building skills, agents and workflows with AI at their core, and the shared platform where they are deployed and secured. You'll be the first engineer dedicated to this shared platform, working directly with the VP AI Engineering and with support from senior engineers across Harmonic.
Your time will be split roughly evenly between applied AI engineering, building the solutions, and platform and DevOps, the foundation they run on. Early on there is more platform work, as we set up things like agent deployment and a marketplace for sharing AI tools. As the platform matures, the balance moves towards building.
You'll partner closely with TechOps, Engineering, Security and the business teams we build with.
## What You'll Do
You will be building and supporting the solutions and platform that let the whole company scale through AI, taking advantage of the latest vendor tools and capabilities. You'll use AI coding tools every day to do your work.
## Applied AI Solutions that Work Company-Wide
Design and build AI skills, agents and workflows that use the latest models, tools and capabilities, working with the people who do the job.
Develop colleagues' ideas and prototypes into secure, scalable, cost effective companywide solutions.
Build and deploy shared AI capabilities as skills, agents, connectors and more.
Write tests and evaluations from real examples, and run them in CI within cost limits.
Monitor shared skills, agents and connectors, maintain and tune what's working, retire what isn't used.
Track, experiment with and evaluate the latest AI vendor features and tools as they are released.
## Platform & DevOps: The Foundation Our AI-Powered Solutions Run On
Build and run shared AI infrastructure as code, reviewed and deployed through CI/CD pipelines, today on AWS, with Terraform and GitLab.
Deploy and operate secure connectors (MCP servers) so AI can act with the right constraints and permissions, with secrets managed centrally.
Build the pipeline for publishing, versioning and sharing skills, plugins and other AI tools.
Maintain and operate scheduled and triggered agents safely, each with its own identity, secrets and monitoring, tracking cost, performance, stability and usage across the platform.
Help colleagues build on the platform with docs, templates and support.
Create, document and maintain standards for AI solutions, such as how agents are deployed, so other teams can adopt them.
## What You Bring
## Engineering foundations
Demonstrable experience of hands-on DevOps, platform or cloud engineering in a real software team. A substantial internship on real production software counts.
Practical cloud infrastructure experience; for example AWS IAM, containers/ECS, S3 and networking basics.
Experience writing and reviewing infrastructure as code, for example with Terraform or OpenTofu, and shipping changes through CI/CD pipelines with a standard Git workflow.
Python (or similar) for tooling and automation, plus Linux and Docker basics.
## Building with AI
Enthusiasm for solving real world problems with AI, shown by something you've built beyond using coding assistants, such as an agent, workflow or integration. A personal, university or work project counts.
Established day-to-day use of AI coding tools, and the habit of checking what they produce.
Awareness of the infrastructure and technical ecosystem that supports AI solutions; for example agent hosting platforms such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, MCP services, plugin marketplaces, LLM APIs and SDKs.
## Working with colleagues
Clear communication with non-engineers: you explain technical choices, trade-offs and limits in plain language, in writing and in conversation.
Curiosity about how other teams work: you ask questions to understand a colleague’s problem before proposing a solution.
You don't need to have had an AI job title or an AI background, and you don't need to match every requirement.
## You Might Be a Fit if You
Are bright, curious, learn fast, and enjoy being the first person to build something.
See AI as a tool to help you build smarter, faster and better, and want to point it at problems that have real impact.
Want to spend at least half your time building AI solutions that colleagues rely on, using the latest tools and capabilities as they emerge.
Like being the link between engineers and the people who do the work.
Enjoy switching hats, moving between technical implementation and collaborating with colleagues.
Like to ship early and iterate.
Thrive in a fast-paced startup where priorities evolve and ambiguity is the norm.
## Why Join Us
This isn't just a job, it's a chance to help define a category, and to build this chapter of the story from its first page. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.
Recognized momentum: named to Rising in Cyber 2026, a signal the market is taking notice
Rare market opportunity: join early in a category-defining company shaping how enterprises tackle one of tech's biggest unsolved problems
Competitive pay and meaningful equity: a real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture
Comprehensive benefits: 401K, generous PTO
A small, high-trust team: transparency, creativity, continuous learning, no politics, no bureaucracy
Thoughtful leadership that cares about your growth, not just your output
Annual global off-sites: past trips include Lisbon and Nashville
Real ownership: you'll shape a new part of the company from day one
## Harmonic's Core Values
## 🌱 Flourish in the Unknown
We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.
## 🔥 Never Full
We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.
## 🤝 Perfect Harmony
We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work.

Interview with Talent Acquisition representative
Interview with Hiring Manager
Recruitment Challenge
The role

Analytical & Prototyping Mindset: Ability to analyze technical documentation, work with data/on-chain telemetry, evaluate emerging technologies, and build quantitative models or prototype tools.

The opportunity to learn about digital assets and blockchain from a 30,000 ft view of the entire ecosystem
Working from one of Brussels newest, nicest and most advanced office spaces

Culture of Excellence - we value nimbleness, drive for success, owner mentality and collaboration.
Opportunity to leave your mark and start your career in one of the most reputable companies in the digital assets world

Our recruitment philosophy
We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

## What you'll do
We build software in a lean and pragmatic way, and care about choosing the right abstractions for our domain and continuously balance delivery speed against long-term complexity.
Our stack includes Typescript, React Native, modern PHP and PostgreSQL. We prefer to work with people who have seen—or want to learn—different technologies, as we consider our tools a means to an end.
You will:
Work with a small team of product owners and product designers to implement new app features.
Help validate features work as intended, from analysing technical telemetry to joining customer interviews.
Code across our stack — frontend and backend.
Ship often and take responsibility for your code “in the field”.

Have several years of experience with developing for mobile.

Care about code quality and long-term maintainability.
Enjoy working directly with product designers and our customers.
Are comfortable taking responsibility for production systems.

title: [Paris] Applied AI Architect, Industries
description:
## About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
## About the role
As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic, you will be a pre-sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
## Responsibilities:
Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success
Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
## You may be a good fit if you have:
5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
Native or fluent French speaker (C1 or above)
Experience working with enterprise customers, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
Comfortable with python
Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
À propos du poste
Au sein de l’équipe Applied AI d’Anthropic, vous intervenez comme architecte avant-vente, avec un objectif : devenir le conseil technique de confiance des grandes entreprises. Vous les aidez à comprendre la valeur de Claude et à se projeter sur la façon de l’intégrer et de le déployer avec succès dans leur environnement technologique. Vous alliez une expertise technique pointue à un vrai sens du client pour concevoir des solutions innovantes à base de LLM, qui répondent à des enjeux métier complexes tout en respectant nos exigences élevées de sécurité et de fiabilité.
En lien étroit avec nos équipes Sales, Produit et Engineering, vous accompagnez les clients depuis le cadrage technique initial jusqu’au déploiement. Vous mettez votre expertise à leur service pour leur faire comprendre les capacités de Claude, construire des évaluations et concevoir des architectures évolutives qui tirent le meilleur de nos systèmes d’IA.
Vos responsabilités
• Travailler avec les account executives pour comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients et les traduire en solutions techniques, en alignant objectifs métier et mise en œuvre
• Être le conseil technique principal des grands comptes tout au long de leur adoption de Claude, du cadrage à l’évaluation initiale puis au déploiement, en coordonnant en interne les différentes équipes et parties prenantes pour assurer leur réussite
• Accompagner les clients qui développent aussi bien avec l’API Claude qu’avec Claude for Work
• Créer et présenter des contenus techniques, adaptés à chaque public : aussi à l’aise dans une session technique approfondie avec des équipes d’ingénierie que dans une discussion sur la valeur métier avec des dirigeants
• Orienter les choix d’architecture et aider les clients à intégrer efficacement Claude dans leur environnement technologique existant
• Aider les clients à mettre en place des cadres d’évaluation pour mesurer la performance de Claude sur leurs cas d’usage
• Identifier les schémas d’intégration récurrents et faire remonter ces enseignements à nos équipes Produit et Engineering
• Vous déplacer ponctuellement chez les clients pour des ateliers, des sessions techniques et pour développer la relation
• Vous tenir à jour des dernières évolutions des LLM, de leurs capacités et de leurs modes de mise en œuvre
Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous avez
• Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans des fonctions techniques en contact avec les clients, comme Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer ou Technical Account Manager
• Un français natif ou de niveau C1, et un anglais courant
• L’expérience des grands comptes et des cycles d’achat complexes impliquant de nombreuses parties prenantes
• Une capacité exceptionnelle à créer des relations et à expliquer des concepts techniques à des interlocuteurs variés : comités de direction, équipes d’ingénierie et IT, entre autres
• D’excellentes qualités de communication technique, pour faire le lien entre les besoins des interlocuteurs techniques et métier
• L’expérience de la conception d’architectures cloud évolutives et de l’intégration aux systèmes d’entreprise
• De l’aisance avec Python
• Une bonne connaissance des frameworks et outils LLM courants, ou un parcours en machine learning ou en data science
• Le goût de transmettre, d’accompagner et d’aider les autres à réussir
• D’excellentes qualités relationnelles et de communication : vous savez rendre simples des sujets complexes pour des interlocuteurs internes et externes très différents. Vous aimez collaborer au-delà de votre équipe, arbitrer et concilier des priorités parfois concurrentes
• L’envie de réfléchir de façon créative à une utilisation sûre et bénéfique de la technologie, au service du développement d’une IA sûre
Date limite de candidature
Aucune. Les candidatures sont étudiées au fil de l’eau.
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.
For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
Annual Salary:
€190.000—€220.000 EUR
## Logistics
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
## How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
## Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: [GSD] AI Tools Support Engineer  (Bangkok Based)
description:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
The Opportunity:
AI Tools Support Engineer will provide advanced support and enablement for AI and productivity tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, internal GPT solutions) used across Agoda. The role partners closely with the GPT Tool Team, translating end‑user needs and issues into scalable solutions, documentation, and improvements. This person will own L2–L3 support, drive safe and effective adoption of AI tools, and act as a bridge between end users, IT, and the GPT Tool Team.
What You’ll Do:
• Provide L2–L3 support for AI and productivity tools, including troubleshooting, incident handling, and escalations.
• Meet and help define SLAs for response and resolution times, ensuring tickets and incidents are handled within agreed timelines.
• Proactively monitor queues, prioritize issues based on impact/severity, and communicate clearly with users on status and next steps.
• Work closely with the GPT Tool Team to relay user feedback, common issues, and feature requests into product and configuration improvements.
• Create and maintain self‑service guides, FAQs, and playbooks to reduce recurring tickets and improve user experience.
• Monitor usage patterns and support trends; propose process, policy, or tooling changes to improve reliability and adoption.
• Collaborate with security, IT, and engineering teams to ensure safe, compliant, and governed use of AI tools.
• Support trainings, onboarding materials, and internal communications to help users adopt AI tools effectively.
Required Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• At least 2 years of experience in technical support, IT support, productivity tools support, or similar user‑facing technical role.
• Strong understanding of modern SaaS / productivity tooling; familiarity with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Cursor) or willingness and ability to ramp up quickly.
• Solid troubleshooting skills and ability to investigate issues across user, configuration, and basic integration layers.
• Experience writing clear user‑facing documentation (how‑to guides, FAQs, internal wiki pages).
• Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
• Proven track record of driving improvements in support processes, knowledge base, or tooling.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience working with LLMs, chatbots, or AI-powered productivity tools in an enterprise environment.
• Basic scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Google Apps Script) to help with analysis or simple tools.
• Experience partnering with product/engineering teams and representing end-user needs.

title: AI Engineer Intern (x/f/m) - Paris
description:
Join a team of passionate and committed people working to improve healthcare.

At Doctolib, our tech teams build products and features that improve the daily lives of healthcare professionals and patients. We work in feature teams within an agile environment, in close collaboration with Product, Design, Data Science, and Business teams.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

We are looking for an AI Engineer Intern to join our Tech team and contribute to the development of AI-powered features at Doctolib.

You will work closely with experienced AI and software engineers to explore, prototype, evaluate, and improve AI-based solutions. This internship will give you the opportunity to gain practical experience across the different stages of an AI product, from experimentation to integration into a production environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

 - Contribute to the development of AI features and services under the guidance of experienced engineers

 - Write Python code to support prototypes, experiments, evaluation tools, and backend components

 - Experiment with large language models, prompting techniques, retrieval, and tool integration

 - Contribute to automated tests and documentation for the components you develop

 - Investigate issues, analyse results, and suggest improvements to your team

 - Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and team rituals

You will receive regular guidance from your mentor and teammates. The scope of your work will grow progressively as you become familiar with the codebase, the tools, and the technical challenges.


WHO YOU ARE

Before you read on, if you do not have the exact profile described below but feel that this internship matches your skills and interests, we still encourage you to apply.

You will be a great fit if you:

 - Are in the final year of a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related field

 - Have basic experience with Python through coursework, personal projects, research, or previous internships

 - Have a basic understanding of programming concepts, data structures, and software development

 - Are curious about artificial intelligence and interested in understanding how AI systems work

 - Are comfortable communicating in English, both written and spoken

It would be fantastic if you:

 - Have worked on a project involving machine learning, natural language processing, or large language models

 - Have used agentic frameworks like Langchain or Google ADK.

 - Have experimented with AI APIs, prompting, retrieval, or conversational interfaces

 - Have experience in taking products to production and supporting them with real users.

 - Have some experience with Git, APIs, testing, or data analysis

 - Have an interest in healthcare, privacy, or responsible AI


LIFE AT DOCTOLIB TECH

Our products are built on a cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile applications across several countries and healthcare systems.

Even if Doctolib uses technologies like Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Swift, React Native, and many cloud-related technologies, the principal language you'll work on is Python.You will also have the opportunity to use AI-assisted development tools within our engineering practices.

Discover our AI vision here https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/ and learn more about our tech culture on the Doctolib Tech site https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - A structured internship with dedicated mentoring

 - The opportunity to work on real AI projects in a healthcare environment

 - Technical learning sessions and access to internal engineering communities

 - Access to AI tools for coding, development, and learning

 - Meal vouchers

 - Free breakfast in the office

 - Up to 2 days of remote work per week

 - A flexible workplace policy, depending on the team and location

 - A collaborative and international working environment


THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Coding Game

 - Recruiter Interview

 - Technical Interview

 - Behavioral Interview


JOB DETAILS

 - Internship, 6 months, full-time

 - Location: Berlin, Paris, Nantes, Milan, or Amsterdam

 - Hybrid work setup, up to 2 remote days per week

 - Start date: March 2027


WE WELCOME EVERYONE

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. We evaluate candidates based on their qualifications, motivation, and potential, without discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the better our products can serve patients and healthcare professionals. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability, or place of origin.

To support an inclusive recruitment process, we invite you to leave personal information such as pictures and age off your application. If you require an accommodation during the interview process, please let us know.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Join a team of passionate and committed people working to improve healthcare.

At Doctolib, our tech teams build products and features that improve the daily lives of healthcare professionals and patients. We work in feature teams within an agile environment, in close collaboration with Product, Design, Data Science, and Business teams.

We are looking for an AI Engineer Intern to join our Tech team and contribute to the development of AI-powered features at Doctolib.

title: Research Engineer – Neuro-Symbolic AI (Knowledge Graphs) & Multimodal Assistant Systems
description:
Roles & Responsibilities :
Conduct cutting-edge research in Neuro-Symbolic AI, focusing on the integration of formal knowledge representations such as knowledge graphs with modern machine learning and deep learning techniques.
Design multimodal data pipelines integrating text, structured data, and, where relevant, visual or sensor information.
Design and develop knowledge-driven AI systems with natural language interaction capabilities, enabling explainable, trustworthy, and human-centered AI assistants.
Integrate Neuro-Symbolic reasoning with large language models (LLMs) and multimodal foundation models using knowledge grounding, structured retrieval and reasoning-aware workflows to improve robustness, interpretability, and domain adaptability.
Design, build, and evolve semantic assets — such as ontologies, knowledge graphs, semantic data models, and symbolic rules / constraints — that ground, validate, and explain neuro-symbolic AI systems in production-oriented research settings.
Prototype, evaluate, and validate research concepts through experiments, benchmarks, and real-world use cases, translating research outcomes into scalable solutions.
Collaborate closely with international, cross-disciplinary teams of researchers, engineers, and product stakeholders to apply research innovations to business-relevant scenarios such as product engineering, diagnostics, maintenance, and repair.
Contribute to technology transfer, supporting the transition from research prototypes to production-ready systems in collaboration with software and product teams.
Publish research findings in top-tier conferences and journals, file patents, and contribute to Bosch’s intellectual property portfolio.
Stay up to date with the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, knowledge representation, and multimodal systems, ensuring Bosch remains at the forefront of innovation.
Actively participate in internal and external research communities, workshops, and collaborations to foster knowledge exchange and thought leadership.

Ph.D. or M.S. or M. Tech from top Indian or foreign institutes (IITs, IIITs, IISc etc.) in Computer Science or a related field (e.g., NLP, linguistics, artificial intelligence, cognitive science)

At least 3 years of relevant professional or applied research experience.

Expertise in Neuro-Symbolic AI Architectures and Frameworks: Proven ability to design, implement, and integrate hybrid AI systems that combine machine learning with symbolic reasoning (preferably knowledge graphs) to address complex requirements.
• Advanced Data Engineering for Multi-Modal Integration: Demonstrated proficiency in building robust data pipelines capable of integrating, cleaning, and preprocessing heterogeneous data sources
• Understanding of core NLP concepts and practical experience using state-of-the-art NLP frameworks, libraries (e.g., Hugging Face Transformers, spaCy, NLTK, Gensim etc.) for text processing, tokenization, semantic parsing, and language modeling.
• Proven experience in extracting structured knowledge from unstructured text using NLP techniques like Named Entity Recognition (NER) and Relation Extraction. to understand user queries, extract insights from text, and contribute to the automatic construction and expansion of dynamic knowledge bases.

• Proven ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional and international teams.

• Strong understanding of knowledge representation and reasoning techniques, including ontology design, schema alignment, rule authoring, explainable inference workflows, and hybrid symbolic-neural evaluation methodologies.
• Neuro-Symbolic AI & Hybrid Reasoning: Experience architecting or implementing hybrid reasoning and analytical engines capable of complex problem-solving, including causal reasoning, planning, explainable decision-making, and symbolic-neural inference. Architect and implement hybrid reasoning and analytical engines capable of complex problem-solving, including causal reasoning, planning, explainable decision-making, and symbolic–neural inference.

title: Scholarship in AI for PhD Students

description:
Roles & Responsibilities :
We are looking for a hands-on software engineer with intrinsic motivation to build and run Generative AI workflows for Bosch's global Intellectual Property (IP) organization.
You will own workflows from start to finish. You will work directly with IP attorneys, patent analysts, and engineers to understand how they work. You will turn their problems into clear specifications and ship production tools with an AI-first engineering workflow. You will be responsible for specific workflows yourself and coordinate overall direction with the AI platform lead.
The role is between our AI platform (Python / FastAPI) and our core enterprise IP Management applications. The scope grows with what AI makes possible and what our IP teams need, e.g. semantic search, automated document classification, portfolio intelligence, and strategic decision-support tools.
What You Will Do
• Own workflows end to end: Work with internal users to understand their workflows, prototype and validate ideas in interactive UI frameworks, and bring what works into production, where users run it at scale from our core enterprise platforms, without a middleman.
• Build AI-powered backend services: Design and extend Python / FastAPI services that power IP workflows such as semantic search, automated document analysis, clustering, and structured information extraction.
• Design for the user: Care how the output is used: watch users work, cut steps, and make results easy to review and trust.
• Integrate with our IP Management System: Work with the enterprise applications team so their platform can trigger, consume AI workflows, and contribute on integration of APIs and web interfaces as required.
• Build data pipelines: Ingest and transform data from large-scale external databases and enterprise data platforms, handling rate limits, retries, pagination, and validation.
• Run what you build: Monitor quality, latency and LLM costs in production, and improve prompts, queries and architecture based on real user feedback.
Educational qualification:
• B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science, IT or a related engineering field.
Experience :
• 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, mainly writing production backend code in Python.
Mandatory/requires Skills :
• Experience building REST APIs (FastAPI preferred; Flask/Django acceptable), including async programming, Pydantic validation and authentication.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

## AI Forward Deployed Engineer
## LOCATION
## US or Canada - Remote
## U.S. LOCATIONSMAY INCLUDE
Indianapolis, IN; Arizona; Colorado; Michigan; North Carolina; Ohio; Texas; Virginia
## Role Overview
The AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is the technical owner for strategic customer AI engagements, responsible for turning high-value business problems into working, production-ready AI solutions. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI engineering, solution architecture, and hands-on delivery. The FDE works directly with customer business and technical teams to identify the right problem, rapidly build and validate a solution, deploy it into real operating environments, and continuously optimize it against measurable business outcomes.
This is a builder role. Success requires equal comfort with executive discovery, architecture whiteboarding, writing and debugging code, integrating enterprise systems and data, evaluating agent behavior, and resolving blockers with Product and Engineering. The FDE maintains end-to-end accountability from discovery through production and converts lessons from each engagement into reusable assets that accelerate the next customer.
## Key Responsibilities
· Own customer outcomes end to end. Partner with customer business and technical leaders to identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases, define measurable success criteria, and own the technical outcome from discovery through prototype, live test, production, and optimization.
· Build hands-on. Rapidly prototype, code, configure, integrate, test, and deploy AI solutions using customer systems, APIs, data, workflows, and cloud services.
· Engineer agentic AI systems. Design and optimize agent behavior, prompts, context, tool invocation, orchestration, grounding, retrieval, memory, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
· Connect AI to the enterprise. Develop secure integrations across APIs, webhooks, enterprise applications, data platforms, identity systems, and legacy environments so AI agents can act reliably within real business workflows.
· Validate with engineering rigor. Build evaluation and observability approaches that test accuracy, safety, latency, reliability, and business outcomes; diagnose failures and edge cases and iterate rapidly.
· Move prototypes into production. Apply sound software engineering, security, governance, CI/CD, version control, monitoring, and operational practices to deliver maintainable production solutions.
· Remove production blockers. Work directly with Genesys Product, Engineering, Support, and cross-functional teams to identify platform gaps, resolve technical issues, and unblock customer deployment.
· Co-build with customers. Work alongside customer engineers and architects, transfer knowledge, and leave customer teams more capable of operating and extending the solution after the engagement.
· Create the field-to-product feedback loop. Translate repeatable customer needs, deployment friction, and edge cases into actionable product feedback, feature requests, technical patterns, and reference implementations.
· Build once, scale everywhere. Package proven agents, integrations, prompts, evaluation methods, deployment patterns, and implementation playbooks into reusable assets that accelerate future customer engagements.
· Operate with ownership and urgency. Maintain accountability through resolution, manage ambiguity, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and drive multiple stakeholders toward measurable outcomes.
## Required Qualifications
· 8+ years of relevant technical experience in software engineering, AI engineering, solutions engineering, technical delivery, solution architecture, or a comparable hands-on role; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
· Demonstrated production ownership. Experience taking at least one meaningful software, AI, data, or integration solution from concept or prototype into a production environment and supporting it through real-world use.
· Enterprise integration expertise. Experience designing or building with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication/authorization, structured and unstructured data, and modern cloud or SaaS architectures.
· Applied AI and LLM knowledge. Practical experience with large language models and agentic AI concepts such as prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, orchestration, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation, and guardrails.
· Engineering discipline for AI. Ability to test, debug, monitor, and improve AI systems using repeatable evaluation, tracing, logging, versioning, and software quality practices.
· Customer-facing technical leadership. Ability to lead discovery and technical working sessions, translate ambiguous business problems into buildable technical solutions, and communicate credibly with both senior executives and engineers.
· High-agency execution. A record of learning quickly, making sound tradeoffs, operating effectively with incomplete information, and owning problems through resolution rather than handing them off.
· Collaborative product mindset. Ability to work across Sales, Solution Consulting, Product, Engineering, Support, Security, and customer teams while converting field learnings into reusable patterns and product feedback.
· AI-native development mindset. Comfort using modern AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to accelerate software delivery while remaining accountable for code quality, security, and maintainability.
· AI-assisted engineering tools. Experience using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Amazon Kiro, or similar AI coding environments as part of a regular development workflow.
· Enterprise data and knowledge systems. Experience with vector databases, search, data pipelines, knowledge retrieval, enterprise data platforms, or integrating AI with CRM, ERP, ITSM, or other systems of record.
· Agentic AI experience. Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, tool-using agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, agent-to-agent workflows, or orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
· Travel flexibility. Ability to travel to customer sites and company events as needed for strategic engagements.
## Preferred Qualifications
· Hands-on programming capability. Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or an equivalent language, with the ability and willingness to learn additional technologies quickly.
· Production AI observability and optimization. Experience with evaluation pipelines, tracing, latency and cost optimization, reliability monitoring, safety controls, or LLM-native performance metrics.
· Cloud and deployment experience. Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud and with deployment technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, or serverless architectures.
· Conversational or voice AI experience. Experience building customer-facing conversational AI, virtual agents, voice AI, or contact-center solutions.
· Customer experience domain knowledge. Experience with Genesys Cloud CX, customer experience technology, contact center platforms, workforce engagement, routing, or related enterprise SaaS solutions is valuable but not required.
· Security and responsible AI. Understanding of enterprise security, identity and access management, data privacy, auditability, permissioning, prompt injection risks, and safe tool execution for AI systems.
· Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced technical education is a plus but not required.
The profile we are building: Business thinker. Hands-on builder. Customer technologist. Relentless owner. Builds once, scales everywhere.

title: Data Analyst II
description:
GROW WITH US:
Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.
STAY AWESOME:
Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com
## A DAY IN THE LIFE:
The Data Analyst II supports data-driven decision making by transforming complex data into actionable insights, reports, and analytical solutions. This role partners with stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs, integrate and prepare data from multiple sources, and deliver analyses that improve operational effectiveness and business outcomes. This position combines business analytics, data wrangling, and technical development skills using SQL, Python, and modern analytics platforms.
## Data Analyst II's are also responsible for:
• Uses SQL, Python, and analytics platforms to prepare, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
• Ensures data quality through validation, investigation, and documentation of data sources and methodologies.
• Collaborates with stakeholders across Tandem’s business units to define user needs and develop proof-of-concept analyses, datasets, and visualizations that inform solution design.
• Analyzes data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business insights.
• Develops reports, dashboards, visualizations, and analytical datasets that support business decision-making.
• Presents findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Identifies opportunities to automate and improve reporting and analytical processes.
• Ensures compliance with company policies, including Privacy/HIPAA, and other legal and regulatory requirements.
• Other duties as assigned.
## WHEN & WHERE YOU’LL WORK:
Remote: This position is fully remote and is open to candidates throughout the United States, with a preference for those located in San Diego, California. Equipment for the role will be provided, and training will be conducted remotely.
Schedule: This position will work Monday - Friday from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PMPST.
## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
## 1. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
• Experience with SQL and relational databases.
• Experience using Python for data preparation, analysis, and automation.
• Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Strong data wrangling and data modeling skills.
• Ability to work with large, complex datasets.
• Attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
## Minimum Certifications/Educational level:
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field
• Master's degree in a related field may substitute for the required experience.
## Minimum Experience:
• Two (2) years of related experience in Data Analytics.
Preferred experience in any of the following areas:
• Experience translating business questions and stakeholder needs into analytical requirements, metrics, and reporting solutions.
• Experience working in a regulated industry, such as medical device, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or healthcare.
• Experience with Databricks or other cloud-based analytics platforms.
• Experience integrating data from multiple business systems
• Experience supporting cross-functional business initiatives.
• Experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and supporting team backlog management using tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
• Knowledge of statistical analysis and modeling techniques preferred.
## COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:
The base pay for this position is $82,000 - $100,000 annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes incentive compensation, equity, and a robust benefits package.
Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!
## YOU SHOULD KNOW:
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.
Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.
SPONSORSHIP: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at .
## BE YOU, WITH US!
We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.
Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.
REFERRALS:
We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!
APPLICATION DEADLINE:
The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.
Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

title: Data Engineer Tester - Healthcare Data & AI Validation - Remote (Philadelphia, P
description:
Req ID:398012
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
We are currently seeking a Data Engineer Tester - Healthcare Data & AI Validation - Remote to join our team in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (US-PA), United States (US).
Data Engineer Tester (2 Positions) – Healthcare Data & AI Validation
Industry: Healthcare / Life Sciences / Biotechnology
## Position Overview
We are seeking two experienced Data Engineer Testers to support the quality assurance, data integrity, and regulatory validation of an enterprise-scale medical data ingestion and automation platform.
These individuals will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive testing strategies across complex ETL pipelines, large-scale data processing environments, and AI-driven data mapping solutions. The platform processes substantial volumes of structured and unstructured healthcare data, including clinical records, pathology reports, and other medical datasets.
The successful candidates will validate data ingestion, transformation, mapping accuracy, semantic alignment, and overall pipeline performance. A key component of the role will involve testing and validating outputs generated by Machine Learning models, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies to ensure data accuracy and alignment with established healthcare standards and medical ontologies.
Candidates should bring a combination of hands-on data engineering, automated testing, big data quality assurance, and healthcare or life sciences domain experience.
## Key Responsibilities
## Data Pipeline & ETL Testing
• Design, develop, and execute automated testing frameworks to validate complex ETL pipelines and large-scale data transformations.
• Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across ingestion, processing, transformation, and output stages.
• Develop SQL and Python-based scripts to perform data reconciliation, validation, and automated quality checks.
• Test data processing workflows across distributed environments and large-scale platforms.
• Identify, document, and troubleshoot data discrepancies, transformation defects, and pipeline failures.
## AI-Driven Data Mapping & Model Validation
• Develop testing strategies to validate automated data mapping and semantic alignment generated by Machine Learning models and LLMs.
• Verify AI-generated mapping outputs against established healthcare data standards, medical terminologies, and biomedical ontologies.
• Evaluate mapping accuracy, precision, consistency, and completeness across diverse clinical and medical datasets.
• Develop test datasets and validation benchmarks to assess model performance and identify mapping errors or inconsistencies.
• Collaborate with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to investigate defects and improve model validation processes.
## Performance, Load & Scalability Testing
• Conduct performance, stress, and load testing across high-volume data ingestion and processing pipelines.
• Benchmark data throughput, processing speed, resource utilization, and system responsiveness under varying workloads.
• Validate distributed data processing performance across technologies such as PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS EMR.
• Assess pipeline performance in environments utilizing specialized AI hardware, including NVIDIA GPUs and Google TPUs.
• Identify performance bottlenecks and collaborate with engineering teams to improve processing efficiency and scalability.
## Unstructured Data & NLP Validation
• Develop and execute test cases for NLP and Named Entity Recognition (NER) models processing unstructured clinical information.
• Validate the accuracy of extracted medical entities, terminology, relationships, and clinical information from medical records and pathology reports.
• Test entity recognition, classification, normalization, and semantic extraction outputs.
• Verify that extracted information is correctly mapped to standardized medical terminologies and data structures.
## Regulatory Compliance & Data Quality Assurance
• Validate data lineage, traceability, audit logging, and security controls throughout the data processing lifecycle.
• Ensure testing practices support applicable healthcare and life sciences regulatory and privacy requirements, including HIPAA, GDPR, and relevant GxP requirements.
• Verify data handling, access controls, and documentation requirements within regulated healthcare data environments.
• Maintain test documentation, execution evidence, defect records, and validation results to support auditability and compliance.
## Test Management & Defect Resolution
• Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, and automated regression suites.
• Track testing progress, defects, and resolution activities using Jira or Azure DevOps.
• Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and Business Analysts to resolve technical issues.
• Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, testing reviews, defect triage, and release readiness assessments.
## Required Qualifications
• 3–5 years of professional experience in Data Testing, Data Engineering, Big Data Quality Assurance, or Software Testing focused on data-intensive applications.
• 1–2+ years of experience within Healthcare, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical, or related regulated data environments.
• Hands-on experience testing complex ETL pipelines, data transformations, and large-scale data processing workflows.
• Strong SQL and Python programming skills for data validation, reconciliation, and test automation.
• Experience validating structured and unstructured datasets and identifying data quality issues.
• Understanding of automated data testing, regression testing, performance testing, and defect management.
• Familiarity with healthcare data standards, clinical data models, and medical terminology.
• Experience working with technical teams in Agile or enterprise software delivery environments.
## Technical Skills & Qualifications
## Data Engineering & Big Data Platforms
• Strong SQL and Python programming capabilities.
• Experience with PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, and/or AWS EMR.
• Understanding of distributed data processing, ETL architecture, data ingestion, and transformation workflows.
• Experience testing large datasets across cloud-based data platforms.
## Automated Testing & Data Validation
• Hands-on experience with data quality and testing frameworks such as:
• Great Expectations
• dbt Testing
• PyTest
• Automated SQL-based validation frameworks
• Git-based CI/CD testing and validation pipelines
• Experience developing automated data reconciliation, regression, and quality assurance scripts.
## AI/ML & Infrastructure Testing
• Working knowledge of Machine Learning, LLMs, NLP, and AI-assisted data mapping.
• Understanding of model output validation, semantic mapping, entity extraction, and data classification.
• Familiarity with GPU/TPU-accelerated computing environments, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance testing of associated data pipelines.
• Exposure to NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, Google TPUs, or comparable AI computing environments is an asset.
Healthcare Data Standards & Medical Ontologies
Working knowledge of healthcare data standards and medical terminology, including:
• HL7 and FHIR
• OMOP Common Data Model (OMOP CDM)
• SNOMED CT
• LOINC
• ICD-10
## Test Management & Development Tools
• Experience with Jira and/or Azure DevOps for test management, requirements traceability, defect tracking, and reporting.
• Familiarity with Git, CI/CD workflows, and automated test execution.
## Education
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Bioinformatics, Health Informatics, or a related technical discipline.

This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.
This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.
