title: Modular Product Developer
description:
You’ve discovered something special. A company that cares. Cares about leading the way in construction, engineering, manufacturing and renewable energy. Cares about redefining how energy is designed, applied and consumed. Cares about thoughtfully growing to meet market demands. And ─ as “one of the Healthiest 100 Workplaces in America” ─ is focused on the mind/body/soul of team members through our Culture of Care.
The Modular Product Developer works within the Product Development organization to execute development activities for ETO Modular Product Platforms under the direction of Product Architects. This individual transforms conceptual requirements, sketches, technical direction, and evolving design decisions into accurate virtual prototypes, models, drawings, submittals, and supporting technical documentation.
The primary focus of this role is early concept development using Revit and other digital design tools to rapidly visualize, evaluate, and refine product solutions before design intent is established. The Product Developer maintains sufficient technical understanding of the complete product to accurately represent dimensions, clearances, interfaces, equipment arrangements, constructability, manufacturability, and site integration within concept-level models and documentation. As concepts mature, the Product Developer supports development and maintenance of master Revit models, reusable BIM content, product configuration content, Product Requirements Document (PRD) supporting information, Component Definition Documents (CDDs), specifications, scope documents and matrices, Illustrated Basis of Design (iBODs), client submittals, vendor- and site-specific submittals, permit submittals, ETO submittal packages, and early Long Lead Equipment (LLE) Bills of Material (BOMs).
The Modular Product Developer collaborates with Product Architects, peer Product Developers, Program Design Managers, Preconstruction, engineering disciplines, subject matter experts (SMEs), Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), Detailed Design, Construction Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Construction, Operations, vendors, manufacturers, and other cross-functional stakeholders to incorporate requirements, constraints, design changes, and lessons learned into product development deliverables.
Success in this role requires strong technical modeling capability, product thinking, creativity, curiosity, attention to detail, and active participation in a collaborative product development environment. The Modular Product Developer is expected to understand how concept decisions affect downstream engineering, procurement, fabrication, manufacturing, construction integration, and overall product lifecycle performance.
## MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
Education: Vocational or Technical Certificate, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's Degree in engineering drafting or design, engineering technology, industrial technology, manufacturing design, mechanical design, electrical design, architecture, construction, or a related technical field. Equivalent relevant experience may include electrical or mechanical trades, modular construction, manufacturing, field engineering, VDC/BIM, or project management within an engineering or specialty-contractor environment.
Experience:5+ years of experience in product development, engineering design, BIM/VDC, modular construction, manufacturing, electrical or mechanical construction, or a related technical environment.
## Travel: 10-50%
Work Schedule:This position works between the hours of 6 am and 6 pm, Monday through Friday. Schedule may vary and can include, but is not limited to nights, weekends, and holidays. Overtime may be required. Ability to work a flexible schedule is necessary.
## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Execute and be directly accountable for assigned product development activities and deliverables under the technical direction of Product Architects, ensuring work is complete, accurate, on schedule, and aligned with established product requirements, architecture, standards, and design intent.
• Develop virtual prototypes, product concepts, component designs, and technical solutions that support early concept development, client solutioning, technical evaluation, and rapid design iteration.
• Translate conceptual requirements, sketches, engineering direction, and evolving technical decisions into accurate, constructable digital models.
• Develop and maintain master Revit models, reusable BIM content, families, templates, standardized details, and product configuration content under Product Architect direction.
• Produce accurate 2D concept drawings, layouts, design-intent documentation, submittal packages, and presentation-ready technical documentation.
• Support development of client, programmatic, vendor-specific, site-specific, permit, and ETO product submittal packages through approval.
• Support development and maintenance of CDDs, iBODs, design narratives, and other product-definition deliverables; perform scope leveling through specifications, scope documents and matrices, and Comply, Deviate and/or Exclude (CDE) documentation.
• Support development, validation, and maintenance of early Long Lead Equipment (LLE) Bills of Material (BOMs) and other product data required to support strategic procurement.
• Review and mark up specifications, vendor and equipment submittals, and technical documentation to identify requirements, gaps, deviations, and information requiring incorporation into product models and documentation.
• Coordinate with Product Architects, peer Product Developers, SMEs, engineering disciplines, and cross-functional stakeholders to incorporate requirements, interfaces, constraints, and design changes into product deliverables.
• Maintain model and drawing accuracy for dimensions, clearances, interfaces, equipment layouts, accessibility, constructability, and manufacturability appropriate to the maturity of the design.
• Ensure product models and documentation clearly communicate approved design intent and are suitable for transition to downstream Detailed Design.
• Support establishment of the engineering baseline from which Detailed Design develops production-level models, Engineering Bills of Material (EBOMs), fabrication documentation, manufacturing documentation, and engineering releases.
• Read, understand, and incorporate relevant information from construction design documents to ensure modular products integrate successfully with the overall facility and site design.
• Coordinate with vendors and manufacturers to obtain and validate product data, equipment information, materials, and technical documentation required to support development activities.
• Conduct research on products, components, materials, manufacturers, processes, and technologies to support technical decisions and product improvement.
• Actively participate in product development meetings, design reviews, and technical workshops by presenting concepts, solution ideas, research, technical findings, and recommendations.
• Support development and maintenance of schedules for assigned product development activities and deliverables using applicable planning tools.
• Organize and manage models, drawings, supporting documentation, file structures, revisions, and version control in accordance with company standards and product-development workflows.
• Identify innovative opportunities to reduce cost and improve standardization, manufacturability, constructability, quality, reusable content, and execution efficiency.
• Capture and incorporate lessons learned from Detailed Design, Procurement, Fabrication, Manufacturing, Construction, site deployment, and Operations into updated product models and development deliverables.
• Collaborate with peer Product Developers to develop and continuously improve product design, modeling, documentation, and development best practices.
• Complete assigned development activities accurately, completely, and on schedule while maintaining strong attention to technical quality and product integrity.
## Technical Capabilities
• Develop ETO and complex engineered products, including modular, prefabricated, and construction-integrated systems.
• Translate concepts, sketches, specifications, and technical requirements into accurate digital models, designs, and documentation.
• Develop 2D drawings, layouts, submittal packages, and presentation-ready technical documentation.
• Apply virtual prototyping, concept development, and rapid design iteration to support product development.
• Interpret multidisciplinary technical documentation, including electrical, mechanical, structural, architectural, and construction drawings.
• Read and interpret single-line diagrams, control diagrams, equipment layouts, process piping diagrams, and related technical documents.
• Review and implement equipment and product submittals, specifications, scope documents, matrices, and CDE (Comply, Deviate, Exclude) requirements.
• Conduct independent research to evaluate equipment, materials, manufacturers, components, processes, and technical solutions.
• Support workflows spanning design, procurement, fabrication, manufacturing, construction integration, and site deployment.
• Develop and maintain standardized, reusable design content and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Apply applicable codes, standards, and safety requirements, including NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA, and relevant industry standards.
## Software Proficiency
• Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Revit, including BIM, model development, families, schedules, documentation, and reusable content.
• Demonstrate strong proficiency in Bluebeam Revu and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
• Demonstrate working proficiency in Autodesk Inventor and Vault (PDM).
• Demonstrate familiarity with Autodesk Forma, Fusion Manage (PLM), Acumatica (ERP), Navisworks, Microsoft Office 365, Excel, and MS Project.
• Adapt to and maintain proficiency with evolving digital engineering, product development, and company-standard technologies.
• Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills, and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate.
## How Does FTI Give YOU the Chance to Thrive?
If you’re energized by new challenges, FTI provides you with many opportunities. Joining FTI opens doors to redefine what’s possible for your future.

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

Upstart’s Marketplace Optimization team is part of Capital Marketplace Engineering and is responsible for optimizing Upstart’s two-sided capital marketplace. • Experience building and operating business-critical systems with demonstrated use of testing, monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis.
• Experience designing production systems where reliability, availability, observability, and correctness are critical.

• Experience with marketplaces, financial systems, recommendation or matching engines, optimization systems, or experimentation platforms.

title: GTM Data Analyst
description:
## About Bask Health
Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.
Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.
We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.
We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.
## About the Role
We're looking for a GTM Data Analyst to help Bask Health improve how we collect, analyze, and use data across our go-to-market organization.
You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Revenue Operations to develop reporting, analyze commercial performance, and connect information across our merchant accounts, sales pipeline, contracts, and revenue systems.
This role focuses on making commercial data more reliable and useful. You'll build dashboards, investigate trends, identify data quality issues, and help teams understand how sales activity and merchant relationships contribute to business performance.
You'll also support the development of consistent metrics and reporting processes that help leadership make informed decisions about acquisition, retention, expansion, and commercial priorities.
We're looking for someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, comfortable working with multiple data sources, and able to turn complex information into clear recommendations.
## What You'll Do
• Analyze go-to-market performance across Bask's sales and customer-facing teams.
• Develop and maintain dashboards tracking pipeline, conversion, merchant acquisition, and commercial performance.
• Connect data from CRM systems, merchant accounts, contracts, usage records, and billing platforms.
• Establish consistent reporting for key GTM performance metrics.
• Analyze sales pipeline trends and identify changes in commercial performance.
• Evaluate conversion rates across relevant sales stages and merchant segments.
• Support Sales leadership with reporting on acquisition performance and pipeline activity.
• Analyze merchant acquisition trends to identify patterns and potential opportunities.
• Partner with Customer Success to understand merchant retention, expansion, and account performance.
• Develop reports connecting commercial activity with merchant revenue outcomes.
• Work with Finance and Revenue Operations to validate commercial reporting data.
• Identify inconsistencies between CRM records, merchant account information, and financial systems.
• Investigate missing, duplicate, or inaccurate commercial records.
• Support the development of consistent account ownership and merchant identification processes.
• Analyze sales performance across relevant segments, account groups, and commercial activities.
• Develop recurring reports for commercial leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Support analysis of merchant cohorts and changes in account activity over time.
• Identify patterns that may indicate merchant expansion opportunities.
• Analyze commercial performance differences across acquisition channels or sales motions.
• Support forecasting and planning teams by preparing reliable historical datasets.
• Evaluate pipeline coverage and conversion trends relevant to commercial planning.
• Develop reporting that compares commercial performance against established targets.
• Identify significant performance changes and investigate potential causes.
• Collaborate with Revenue Analytics to connect GTM activity with revenue performance.
• Work with Pricing and Billing Operations when commercial data affects revenue accuracy.
• Support investigations into discrepancies between contract terms, account information, and reported revenue.
• Build and maintain SQL queries for recurring commercial analysis.
• Develop analytical models that organize information from multiple business systems.
• Create documentation for GTM metrics, data definitions, and reporting methodologies.
• Help establish data quality checks for important commercial datasets.
• Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and data preparation.
• Partner with technical teams when analytics improvements require system or data pipeline changes.
• Support ad hoc analytical requests from Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Revenue Operations.
• Prepare clear summaries of analytical findings and business implications.
• Identify opportunities to improve the visibility and reliability of commercial performance data.
• Monitor reporting accuracy and investigate unexpected changes in key metrics.
• Support improvements to Bask's GTM reporting infrastructure and analytical processes.
• Help teams use commercial data more consistently in planning and decision-making.
## Requirements
• 3+ years of experience in GTM Analytics, Sales Analytics, Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, or a related field.
• Strong SQL skills for querying, joining, and validating datasets.
• Advanced spreadsheet skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and analytical models.
• Experience developing dashboards and recurring business performance reports.
• Experience analyzing sales pipeline, conversion, customer acquisition, or commercial performance data.
• Strong understanding of B2B sales and customer lifecycle metrics.
• Experience working with CRM data and commercial reporting systems.
• Ability to connect information from multiple business systems.
• Experience identifying and investigating data quality issues.
• Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills.
• Experience developing consistent business metric definitions and reporting methodologies.
• Ability to interpret commercial performance trends and explain relevant business drivers.
• Experience working with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, or Revenue Operations teams.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
• Ability to organize and analyze large datasets.
• Experience preparing analytical findings for business stakeholders.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to explain complex data clearly to nontechnical audiences.
• Experience documenting analytical processes, datasets, or reporting logic.
• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple reporting requests.
• Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of analytical projects.
• Ability to prioritize business questions and deliver actionable analysis.
• Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
## Nice to Have
• Experience in GTM analytics at a SaaS or technology company.
• Experience analyzing merchant acquisition or e-commerce platform performance.
• Familiarity with subscription, transaction-based, or usage-based revenue models.
• Experience connecting CRM, billing, usage, and customer account data.
• Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM systems.
• Experience with Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar reporting platforms.
• Familiarity with data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.
• Experience using Python for data analysis or reporting automation.

title: Software Engineer - Auth
description:
## About Supabase
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.
## About the role
Auth, written in Go (server) and with client libraries for TypeScript, SSR and for other frameworks and technologies, is one of the most popular products in the Supabase stack. We are seeking someone to help us build new and maintain existing Auth features.
## What you’ll be responsible for
Designing and implementing secure, scalable authentication features in Go and TypeScript.
Working across the stack: from server-side protocols to client-side libraries for frameworks like Next.js.
Owning the performance, reliability, and scalability of the Auth server across Supabase's infrastructure.
Contributing to the evolution of our Auth architecture, including support for OAuth, OIDC, SAML, and other protocols.
Planning and executing safe database migrations across a large fleet of Postgres instances.
Building and improving observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, and dashboards to keep the system healthy at scale.
Writing and reviewing RFCs as part of our product development process.
Collaborating with engineers across Supabase to ensure a seamless experience for developers using our tools.
Supporting the community and responding to developer feedback on GitHub, Discord, and other channels.
## You might be a good fit if you
(Required) Have 4+ years of professional experience writing and shipping Go in production.
(Required) Have 2+ years of professional experience working on an authentication system (implementing protocol support, maintenance at scale).
(Required) Have strong relational database experience (Postgres or MySQL); Postgres experience is a bonus.
Have strong knowledge of TypeScript in addition to Go (languages used daily).
Have strong knowledge of web technology fundamentals (cookies, sessions, JWT, HTTP, browser APIs).
Have good knowledge of and deep interest in authentication security (passwords, protocols such as OAuth, OIDC or SAML, cryptography fundamentals such as hash functions, signatures and ciphers).
Have experience working with multiple web frameworks like Next.js (or other SSR alternative in the JavaScript space) and traditional web frameworks like Ruby on Rails, Django, Laravel or equivalent (in any language).
Have good technical writing skills (RFC process is an important part of making changes to the Auth product).
Have hands-on experience building and operating services at significant scale.
Have deep understanding of systems-level concerns: memory management, concurrency patterns, and compute resource optimization in Go.
Have experience with Kubernetes and AWS (or comparable cloud platform) in a production setting.
Have solid grasp of observability practices — metrics, distributed tracing, structured logging, and alerting (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
Have experience managing database schema migrations safely at scale.
## What We Offer
Fully Remote
We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.
ESOP
Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
Tech Allowance
Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.
Health Benefits
Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
Annual Off-Sites
Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
Flexible Work
We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
Professional Development
Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
## About the Team
Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.
~400 team members
60+ countries
20+ languages spoken
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)
540,000+ community members
We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.
Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.
We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.
We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.
We're hiring our first Data Engineer to own Superchat's data platform end to end, from raw product and business data to the gold tables the whole company reports on. Our engineers have already built the foundations, including a warehouse, pipelines, dbt and reverse ETL. Now we need someone to make the platform trustworthy at scale, with testing, monitoring, clear modelling layers and customer history over time. You'll set the standards for how data is modelled and documented, and work with a Business Analyst to build the gold tables that Finance, Sales, Marketing and Product rely on.
## Who We Want
An experienced Data Engineer.
You bring 3+ years of building and running data pipelines in production, ideally at a SaaS company. You've owned a data platform, or a large part of one, and you're comfortable making the architecture calls yourself.
Strong in SQL and dbt.
You write and review complex SQL with ease. You've built dbt projects with layered models, tests, documentation.
At home in the Cloud.
You have worked with Data Warehouses in the Cloud, ideally AWS Redshift. BigQuery or Snowflake is also fine.
Reliability-minded.
You think in tests, freshness checks, idempotent loads and backfills. You want to know the data is wrong before a stakeholder tells you.
Curious about the business.
You want to know what MRR, churn or an "active workspace" really mean, and you model data so those definitions hold everywhere they're used. Experience with subscription billing or product usage data is a plus.
## Who We Don’t Want
Pure dashboard builder.
You'd rather spend your days building dashboards and answering ad-hoc questions. That's our Business Analyst's job; yours is to build what they work from.
Pure pipeline plumber.
You move data from A to B but don't care what it means. Gold tables are only as good as the business understanding behind them.
Over-engineer.
You want Kafka, Spark and a lakehouse for data that fits comfortably in Redshift. We need pragmatic solutions that fit a 100-person company and can grow with it.
Remote-only operator.
You prefer fully remote work and don't want to build relationships in person. The data platform sits between many teams, and that works best with regular time together in our Berlin office.

• Warehouse: AWS Redshift
• Ingestion: Airbyte, custom Python
• Transformation: dbt
• Orchestration: Dagster
• Reverse ETL: Hightouch
• BI: Metabase
• Infrastructure & CI: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions

• Own ingestion from our product database, Chargebee, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Intercom, Amplitude and other tools, using Airbyte where it works and your own Python where it doesn't.

• Run orchestration in Dagster: schedules, dependencies, freshness checks and alerting, so a stalled sync gets noticed within hours.
• Build data quality in: dbt tests, source checks and CI on every pull request.
• Capture history where our source systems only keep the current state, so a question like "which plan was this customer on last March?" has an answer.
• Run the warehouse: Redshift performance and cost, access management, and AWS infrastructure in Terraform.
• Maintain the reverse ETL syncs (Hightouch) that send data back into HubSpot, Intercom and the other tools our teams work in.

Mission that matters. Real impact on small businesses, not abstract metrics
Funded with conviction. $18M raised and profitable
Real ownership. You own the data platform end to end, not one step of someone else's pipeline
Hybrid by design. Our Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg is the center of gravity, with two work-from-home days as the standard setup
Direct feedback culture. Honest, direct, and kind feedback is part of how we work together - in 1:1s, retrospectives, and everyday collaboration

title: Software Engineer - Production AI Workflows
description:
## How to apply
Email hiring@sunnystep.com with subject: Software Engineer - [Your Full Name]. Include your CV, GitHub/portfolio, and 2-3 examples of production systems you built or shipped. Applications that do not follow this format may not be reviewed.
## About the role
We are building Maxify, an AI-native operating platform where agents own real business workflows, act through company systems and remain accountable to source data, permissions, evaluations and measurable outcomes.
We are looking for a Software Engineer to build and operate production AI workflows on top of our shared platform. You will translate validated business processes into reliable agents that connect to company data, tools and systems and produce measurable outcomes.
This is not a prompt-writing or chatbot role. You will own complete workflows from discovery and tool design through testing, deployment, monitoring and improvement.
## What you will own
• Validate users, pain points, sources of truth, baseline metrics and expected value before building.
• Model business processes as explicit states, actions, decisions, approvals and exception paths.
• Build business-specific agents that complete production workflows end-to-end.
• Develop tools, structured outputs and context strategies.
• Integrate approved APIs, databases and enterprise systems.
• Use deterministic code where probabilistic model behavior is unnecessary or unsafe.
• Create evaluations for completion, accuracy, safety and business outcomes.
• Implement monitoring, escalation, exception handling and human-review paths.
• Diagnose failures and convert repeated issues into tests, guardrails or platform requirements.
• Measure revenue, cost, customer-experience or operational-attention improvement.
## What we are looking for
• Strong production software engineering ability in Python and/or TypeScript.
• Experience building LLM applications, agents or substantial workflow automation.
• Experience with APIs, webhooks, databases and asynchronous processing.
• Ability to translate ambiguous operations into explicit system behavior.
• Understanding of tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, context management and model limitations.
• Experience testing deterministic and non-deterministic systems.
• Strong debugging skills across instructions, application code, data, tools and external services.
• Good judgment about when to use an LLM, deterministic code or human approval.
• Ability to connect engineering work to measurable business outcomes.
• Clear written communication, high agency and rapid learning.
## Strong signals
• You have shipped an agent or automation that performs real actions in production.
• You can demonstrate measurable business impact from something you built.
• You design approval, exception and escalation paths instead of assuming perfect model behavior.
• You use AI development tools heavily while verifying and owning the result.
• You can explain a failed workflow run, identify the root cause and show the prevention mechanism.
• You understand that reliable agents require source data, workflow state, tools, evaluations and observability, not prompts alone.
## Nice to have
• Experience with OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, OpenClaw or comparable systems.
• Experience with Lark/Feishu, Shopify, CRM, accounting or enterprise SaaS integrations.
• Experience with workflow automation or operations-heavy products.
• Familiarity with knowledge graphs, ontology design or governed memory.
• Experience working directly with business teams or customers.
## What this role is not
• Prompt engineering without code or operational ownership.
• Building isolated chatbot demonstrations.
• Pure machine-learning research or model training.
• Pure frontend, data-science or infrastructure work.
• Allowing agents to act without evaluations, permissions or traceability.
## Success in the first 30 days
• Validate one business workflow, its source of truth and baseline performance.
• Map its states, tools, decisions, approvals and exception paths.
• Ship at least one meaningful production improvement.
• Deliver one production workflow on the shared platform.
• Add evaluations covering normal, edge and failure cases.
• Implement monitoring, escalation and human-review paths.
• Demonstrate measurable improvement in speed, quality, cost or customer experience.
• Identify at least one reusable requirement for the shared platform.
These outcomes are subject to timely access and platform readiness.
## How we work
• We move quickly and build for permanence.
• We start from the business outcome and source of truth.
• We use deterministic systems where they are more reliable.
• We treat evaluations, observability and recovery as part of the product.
• AI accelerates the work; it does not remove engineering accountability.
## Interview process
Shortlisted candidates will complete an onsite prototyping test based on a practical AI workflow. We evaluate working output, engineering judgment, effective use of AI tools, debugging ability and clarity of explanation.

title: Data Scientist - #1800
description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a hands-on Data Scientist to support product teams in using data to understand product performance, measure outcomes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
The Data Scientist will work closely with Product Managers, designers, engineers and business stakeholders to embed data and analytics into everyday product decision-making. This includes establishing product metrics, consolidating and analysing data from multiple sources, developing dashboards and generating actionable insights to inform product improvements.
The role will support the full product lifecycle, from initial metric baselining to ongoing performance monitoring, experimentation and analysis as products evolve. The role will leverage Snowflake as the intended data and dashboard platform, alongside PostHog for product analytics and user behaviour tracking.
Key Responsibilities
Product Performance Measurement and Dashboards
Collaborate with Product Managers to translate product outcomes, business questions and hypotheses into measurable metrics.
Establish baselines and develop repeatable methods for tracking product performance over time.
Design, build and maintain interactive, self-service dashboards using Snowflake.
Monitor product and feature performance, proactively identify trends and anomalies, and investigate changes in key metrics.
Continuously improve dashboards and reporting capabilities as products and measurement needs evolve.
Data Preparation, Integration and Management
Extract, clean, transform and consolidate data from multiple sources, including spreadsheets, databases, operational systems and product analytics platforms.
Use Snowflake to query, transform, integrate and analyse data from different sources.
Develop reusable analytical datasets and automate data preparation, integration and reporting processes where feasible.
Support the integration of PostHog event and usage data into Snowflake for consolidated reporting and analysis.
Establish consistent data definitions, metric calculations and data quality checks to ensure reliable and reproducible analysis.
Collaborate with relevant data and engineering teams to resolve data availability, quality and integration issues.
Product Analytics and User Behaviour
Support the setup, configuration and integration of PostHog across selected digital products.
Collaborate with Product Managers, designers and engineers to define, implement and validate event tracking for key user interactions and journeys.
Analyse product usage, feature adoption, conversion funnels, task completion, user journeys and drop-offs.
Analyse session recordings and behavioural data to identify friction points, usability issues and opportunities for product improvement.
Develop dashboards that combine product usage data with relevant operational and business data to provide a more comprehensive view of product performance.
Ensure analytics instrumentation, data collection and analysis comply with applicable security, privacy and data governance requirements.
Data Analysis, Experimentation and Insights
Conduct exploratory and descriptive analysis to identify trends, patterns, anomalies and opportunities for improvement.
Investigate changes in product metrics and perform root-cause analysis to understand potential contributing factors.
Work with Product Managers to define hypotheses, design measurement approaches and evaluate product experiments.
Analyse the impact of product changes to assess whether intended outcomes are being achieved.
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product improvements.
Proactively surface insights through dashboards, concise reports and discussions with product teams.
Support ad hoc analytical investigations throughout the product lifecycle.
Expected Deliverables
The Data Scientist will develop, maintain and enhance the following throughout the engagement:
Product performance dashboards: Interactive, self-service dashboards in Snowflake tracking agreed product outcomes, operational metrics and user behaviour.
Reusable analytical datasets and workflows: Processes for collecting, cleaning, consolidating, transforming and refreshing data from relevant sources.
Product analytics instrumentation: PostHog configurations, event tracking specifications, validated events and integration of relevant usage data into Snowflake.
Performance monitoring and analysis: Initial baselines, ongoing metric monitoring, investigation of anomalies and evaluation of product changes.
Product insights and recommendations: Analyses of user behaviour and product performance, highlighting findings and opportunities for improvement.
Documentation and knowledge transfer: Documentation of data sources, metric definitions, analytical workflows, dashboards and configurations to support continued use and maintenance.
Required Competencies
Hands-on experience in data analysis, preparation, integration and visualisation.
Proficiency in SQL and Python for extracting, manipulating and analysing data.
Experience developing interactive dashboards and analytical visualisations.
Understanding of data modelling, data transformation and the preparation of reusable analytical datasets.
Ability to analyse product performance, identify trends and investigate changes in metrics.
Understanding of statistical analysis, hypothesis testing and experimentation.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and translate them into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and ability to work independently with multidisciplinary teams.
Preferred Competencies
Experience with Snowflake, including SQL-based analytics, data transformation and dashboard development.
Experience with PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel or equivalent product analytics platforms.
Familiarity with event-based analytics, conversion funnels, cohort analysis and user journey analysis.
Experience collaborating with engineers to implement and validate product analytics instrumentation.
Experience supporting product experimentation and evaluating the impact of product changes.
Understanding of product management, user-centred design and outcome-based product development.
Working Arrangements
The Data Scientist will work as an augmented resource embedded within product teams, collaborating closely with Product Managers, designers, engineers and relevant business and data stakeholders.
Product Managers will retain responsibility for defining product objectives, outcomes and priorities. The Data Scientist will provide the technical and analytical expertise to measure performance, generate insights and support evidence-based product decisions.
The engagement will support continuous product measurement and improvement, rather than being limited to initial baselining or dashboard development.

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Backend Developer will be responsible for the design, development, enhancement, and support of backend application services that underpin enterprise digital products and business applications. The role sits within a product delivery team and contributes to the delivery of reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend solutions that support organisational objectives and service delivery outcomes.
The successful candidate will work closely with product owners, business stakeholders, solution architects, quality assurance teams, and fellow software engineers to implement backend services, APIs, and business logic. The role requires hands-on software development experience, participation throughout the software development lifecycle, and ownership of technical deliverables from development through deployment and production support.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Backend Application Development
Develop, enhance, and maintain backend services and application components using Node.js technologies. The role involves translating business and functional requirements into technical solutions, implementing application logic, and ensuring backend components are developed in accordance with established coding standards and engineering practices.
The incumbent will be expected to deliver reliable and scalable solutions, perform code reviews, troubleshoot technical issues, and contribute to the continuous improvement of application architecture and development processes. This includes supporting integration requirements and ensuring backend services are designed with maintainability and performance in mind.
API Design and System Integration
Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and backend interfaces that facilitate secure and efficient communication between systems and applications. The role requires close collaboration with frontend developers and other technical teams to ensure seamless integration across various application components.
The incumbent will analyse integration requirements, implement API services, resolve integration-related issues, and support end-to-end testing activities. Responsibilities also include ensuring that changes are adequately assessed for downstream impacts and that integration solutions align with overall system requirements.
Solution Delivery and Technical Implementation
Participate actively in the delivery of technology initiatives and enhancement projects by contributing to solution design, technical implementation, and deployment activities. The role requires a hands-on approach in estimating development effort, managing assigned deliverables, and ensuring timely completion of project milestones.
The successful candidate will work with project teams to support development activities across the software development lifecycle, including requirement analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support. The focus is on delivering quality software solutions that meet business and operational objectives.
Application Support and Continuous Improvement
Provide technical support for production applications, including root cause analysis, issue investigation, defect resolution, and implementation of corrective actions. The role requires monitoring application performance and working with relevant stakeholders to ensure service stability and availability.
The incumbent will identify opportunities for process optimisation, system enhancement, and technical debt reduction. This includes evaluating existing implementations, recommending improvements, and supporting continuous enhancement initiatives to improve system performance and user experience.
Stakeholder Collaboration and Documentation
Work closely with business users, project teams, and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, communicate technical solutions, and support delivery outcomes. The role requires effective engagement with stakeholders throughout project implementation and operational support activities.
The successful candidate will prepare and maintain technical documentation, including system design artefacts, API specifications, technical procedures, and support documentation. Clear documentation is essential to support knowledge sharing, operational continuity, and future system enhancements.

Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. Candidates should possess relevant software development experience in backend application development environments.
For Consultant-level positions, candidates should typically possess at least 3 to 5 years of relevant software development experience. For Senior Consultant-level positions, candidates should generally possess 6 years or more of relevant experience with demonstrated involvement in the delivery of enterprise application projects and production systems.
Technical Expertise
Strong hands-on experience in backend application development using Node.js and TypeScript. Candidates should possess practical development experience with backend frameworks such as NestJS and/or Express and be comfortable designing, developing, and maintaining server-side application components.
The role requires experience in developing APIs, implementing business logic, troubleshooting application issues, and delivering production-ready software. Candidates should demonstrate sound understanding of software engineering principles, coding standards, and backend application architecture.
Functional and Delivery Experience
Experience participating in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, application design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. Candidates should be able to manage assigned technical deliverables and work effectively within project timelines.
Experience supporting system enhancements, defect resolution, application maintenance, and change implementation activities is required. The ability to analyse technical issues, assess impacts, and implement sustainable solutions will be advantageous.

Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, project managers, quality assurance teams, solution architects, and fellow developers. Candidates should possess strong communication skills and be capable of translating business requirements into technical solutions.

• Design and deliver end-to-end equipment and system integrations across process automation, MES, DeltaV, historians, QA, laboratory and manufacturing operations teams.
• Integrate PLCs (including utilities), upstream/downstream process equipment, alarms, audit-trail and batch data with MES.

• Scripting/programming ability in PowerShell, Python and C#/.NET.
• Understanding of OPC(DA/HDA/UA), PLC/SCADA connectivity and Modbus.
• Experience in GMP/GxP or other regulated environments, including validation documentation.
• Working knowledge of ITIL processes and ServiceNow.

• Exposure to DeltaV batch/alarm data, MES (e.g., Siemens OpCenter) and Kepware.

Analytical problem solving, zero-defect delivery mindset, clear technical documentation, stakeholder communication, and ownership of production-critical systems.
## Success Measures
• No loss of production data; historian availability within agreed SLAs.
• On-time, audit-ready validation packages.
• Reduced recurring incidents through automation and proactive monitoring.

title: Applied AI Engineer, Commercial
description:
## About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
## About the role
As an Applied AI Engineer on the Commercial team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the companies that run the real economy, across software, financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and professional services, as they go from using Claude to building on it. Commercial is one of Anthropic's largest and fastest-moving books of business, covering thousands of mid-market and small companies. Some of these companies put Claude inside the product they sell, and others put agents to work inside their own engineering, operations, finance, and support teams, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with customer engineering teams to take their hardest agent builds from idea to production on the Claude API, the Agent SDK, Claude Managed Agents, Claude Code, and Claude for Enterprise. Many of these teams are lean, with years of existing systems and no dedicated AI function, and you will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what it takes to run it inside a business that already has customers depending on it.
Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll go deep where hands-on engineering changes the outcome, then turn what you learn into something the rest of the book can use. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the reference implementations, tooling, and technical resources that enable Commercial customers to succeed with Claude.
## Responsibilities
• Serve as a deep technical advisor to high-potential Commercial customers, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they run their own business, bringing them use cases worth building and pushing the boundaries of what agents can do in engineering, operations, finance, customer support, and more
• Work hands-on with customer engineering teams through build sprints, pair programming, and architecture reviews that move agents from idea to production, and understand their stack, data, and workflows end to end so that your guidance fits the systems, security requirements, and team they have today
• Ship working code. Develop prototypes, near-production examples, and technical documentation, including evaluation suites that become the customer's acceptance criteria, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable customers to build, operate, and scale with Claude
• Create reference implementations, blueprints, and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, for example multi-agent systems on the Agent SDK or Claude Managed Agents, MCP servers for common business systems, or Claude Code running across the software development lifecycle
• Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects and Account Executives to decide where engineering depth changes the outcome, and to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements
• Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about running agents inside established companies such as legacy systems, messy data, permissions and security review, cost and latency at scale, and model migrations, then build repeatable evaluations and solutions and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team
• Build the demos, agents, and internal tooling that scale the Commercial Applied AI team itself, and pair with architects on their hardest technical problems
• Create technical content for customer and partner engineering audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code
• Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and customer events
• Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building
## You may be a good fit if you have
• Deep software engineering experience, gained by designing, building, and operating production systems, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and how established companies get work done
• 4+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, forward deployed engineer, ML engineer, product engineer, or technical founder, with production experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, MCP, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, and the ability to work in a real codebase in Python or TypeScript, not just notebooks
• A systems mindset and comfort with ambiguity. You'd rather build one thing that serves ten customers than ten things that serve one each, and you have a track record of building structure where the playbook doesn't exist yet
• Strong technical communication skills, with the presence to earn the trust of a customer's engineering leaders, the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans for both technical and business audiences, and the ability to run technical workshops, hackathons, or developer-focused events
• A collaborative approach to working across teams, the range of a generalist who can context-switch from a fintech to a hospital network to a manufacturer and get up to speed on a new business quickly, and a passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.
For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
Annual Salary:
$280,000—$320,000 USD
## Logistics
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
## How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
## Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Software Engineer, Agent Identity
description:
About the Team

The Agent Identity team builds the foundational identity infrastructure that enables AI agents to securely act on behalf of users and organizations. We develop the systems that allow agents to establish their identity, demonstrate whose authority they are operating under, and securely access resources across applications and environments.

Our team owns agent identity and delegation, authentication and authorization, credential lifecycle management, revocation, and integrations with external platforms. We also build Sign in with ChatGPT, enabling OpenAI to serve as an identity provider across a growing ecosystem of applications.

As AI agents become increasingly autonomous, our work is foundational to how users, organizations, and developers establish trust in agentic systems.

About the Role

We are looking for experienced software engineers to design and build the identity infrastructure powering the next generation of AI agents across OpenAI’s products, including ChatGPT and Codex.

You will tackle complex, largely unsolved engineering challenges at the intersection of identity, security, distributed systems, and agent infrastructure. You’ll help define how agents authenticate across environments, how users securely delegate authority to agents, and how agents interact with external applications and services.

This is an opportunity to shape foundational technical primitives at OpenAI while helping influence how the broader industry approaches identity in an increasingly agent-driven world.

In this role, you will:

 - Design and build foundational agent identity primitives, including agent authentication, delegated authorization, and credential lifecycle management.

 - Develop secure mechanisms that enable agents to act on behalf of users and organizations across internal and external systems.

 - Architect authentication and authorization flows for connectors, third-party applications, and cloud-based agent execution environments.

 - Build and evolve Sign in with ChatGPT, enabling secure identity federation and interoperability across the broader application ecosystem.

 - Design highly scalable, reliable, and secure distributed systems that support credential issuance, rotation, revocation, and access enforcement.

 - Partner closely with engineering, product, security, and external platform teams to solve emerging identity challenges and help shape industry standards.

 - Drive technical direction and own complex initiatives from initial architecture through production deployment.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems or business-critical backend infrastructure.

 - Have deep technical experience in identity and access management, workload identity, identity providers, authentication, authorization, or credential lifecycle management.

 - Alternatively, have experience building cloud-based AI agents, agent execution environments, browser-based automation, or connector infrastructure, with firsthand exposure to identity and authentication challenges.

 - Have familiarity with identity and authorization protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, or related emerging standards.

 - Bring a security-first mindset and proactively consider trust boundaries, failure modes, and potential abuse when designing systems.

 - Thrive in ambiguous problem spaces where established technical patterns may not yet exist, and enjoy defining solutions from first principles.

 - Have a track record of driving complex technical initiatives, influencing architectural decisions, and collaborating effectively across engineering teams.

 - Are excited about defining how identity, trust, and delegated authority will work in a world where AI agents increasingly act on our behalf.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Research Engineer, Agentic Systems
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT RAMP LABS

Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research and engineering group. We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 85,000+ companies use to move money.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Most agent work today is one agent, one trace, and a person reads the result. We're building systems where that stops working: thousands of agents fanned out over a large search space, each returning partial results, with an orchestrator that turns all of it into something useful: hundreds of merged PRs, a dataset, the input to another system, or something nobody has built yet.

You'll design and run those systems: how work gets split, how agents coordinate, how results get deduplicated, verified and ranked, and what it all costs. The problems are general (agent swarms, agentic map-reduce, long-running fan-out workflows) and you'll own them from prototype to production.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Decide how the work gets done: how to break a problem down, what each agent sees, how many agents to run, and which model handles which step

 - Squeeze accuracy out of the models: context design, self-verification, voting and consensus across agents, and knowing when more agents stop helping

 - Measure quality without reading every trace: sampling, automated verification, and precision and recall on the final output

 - Drive down cost and latency per useful result: model routing, caching, early stopping, and smaller or fine-tuned models where they hold up

 - Turn one-off experiments into reusable workflows on our existing orchestration stack

 - Evaluate new models, inference setups and training approaches, and bring in what works




WHAT YOU NEED

 - Experience building applied AI systems and LLM applications that shipped

 - Hands-on experience with multi-agent or high-fan-out LLM workloads: parallel agents, map-reduce over models, large batch inference

 - Strong engineering in Python; you build concurrent, distributed systems that hold up in production

 - Judgment about output: you decide what the end result should look like before you scale the swarm, and you can separate signal from agent noise

 - The habit of measuring: cost, yield, false-positive rate, and whether a change actually helped

 - Ownership: you can run a roadmap and a production system with little oversight

 - Clear written communication




NICE-TO-HAVE

 - Built agent orchestration or job systems (Ray, Temporal, Modal or custom)

 - Used LLMs to search large spaces: codebases, document sets, logs or other large corpora

 - Post-training or hosting open-source models for high-volume inference

 - Distributed systems background

 - Public work we can look at: an agent framework, an open-source project, a write-up or a paper






BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

title: Full-Stack & Automation Engineer – SAP Integration and Low-Code (f/m/div.)
description:
We are looking for a Full-Stack & Automation Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of business applications, system integrations and automation solutions across the Bosch environment.
In this role, you will act as a bridge between enterprise systems, cloud platforms, APIs, automation technologies and business processes, delivering pragmatic and scalable solutions that simplify operations and improve efficiency.
You will combine Low-Code development, APIs, SAP integration and Pro-Code capabilities, using technologies such as OutSystems, SAP CPI / SAP Integration Suite and modern programming languages.
We are looking for an all-rounder with a strong problem-solving mindset, business understanding and the ability to quickly translate business needs into effective technical solutions. You will assess different technologies and approaches, balancing speed of delivery, maintainability, scalability and cost.
Your Responsibilities
Low-Code & Application Development
• Design, develop and maintain business applications, primarily using OutSystems.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and rapidly prototype solutions.
• Extend Low-Code applications with custom code whenever required.
SAP Integration & System Connectivity
• Design, develop and maintain integration flows using SAP CPI / SAP Integration Suite.
• Integrate SAP and non-SAP systems through REST, OData and SOAP APIs.
• Work with JSON and XML data structures to ensure reliable data exchange across enterprise platforms.
• Enable connectivity between SAP systems, business applications, automation and AI solutions.
Automation & AI-Ready Solutions
• Identify opportunities to simplify, optimise and automate business processes.
• Support and maintain existing automation solutions, including Automation Anywhere, where applicable.
• Contribute to the evolution of automation towards modern, API-based and AI-enabled solutions.
• Promote robust integration approaches, prioritising API-based connectivity over UI-based automation whenever appropriate.
Pro-Code & Solution Engineering
• Develop APIs, services and custom components using technologies such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Groovy, Java or Python.
• Apply Pro-Code development whenever Low-Code platforms or standard integration capabilities do not fully meet business requirements.
• Evaluate and select the most appropriate technologies for each business challenge.
• Develop reusable and maintainable solutions, following an iterative approach from prototyping and user validation to scalable implementation.
Education:
• Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience & Know-how:
• Professional experience in software development, application integration or automation.

title: SCADA Application Developer (Employed or freelance)
description:
## 📋 Tasks and responsibilities
Join a collaborative development team working on a SCADA system used by dispatchers around the clock to balance a power perimeter across Belgium, France, Germany and the Netherlands. The platform is being expanded to cover a wider geographical area and to integrate additional smaller, flexible assets.
The team develops tools for the real-time control of power plants, the integration of flexibility assets and compliance with European grid codes in support of the energy transition. These tools are used to:
• Monitor production assets and the available capacity of power plants.
• Exchange information between TSOs and the real-time SCADA system, or Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition system.
• Calculate real-time setpoints for power plants based on the production plan, real-time acquisition and other inputs such as FCR, aFRR and mFRR, helping to keep the power perimeter in balance.
FCR stands for Frequency Containment Reserve, aFRR for Automatic Frequency Restoration Reserve and mFRR for Manual Frequency Restoration Reserve. Similar balancing mechanisms are used in other countries.
As part of the development team, you will:
• Develop and maintain the Hitachi Energy MicroSCADA X SYS600 platform, including custom logic and algorithms for real-time automated decision-making.
• Write and maintain back-end logic in SCIL, the native language of the SCADA platform.
• Design and develop clear, responsive web interfaces for dispatchers using HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript or TypeScript within the MicroSCADA framework.
• Work with Git and contribute to the further development of the SCADA landscape through ongoing projects.
• Apply architectural design and software craftsmanship principles such as SOLID, DRY, KISS and YAGNI to create scalable, clean, maintainable and resilient code.
• Collaborate in an Agile environment with analysts, dispatchers and technical teams.
• Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to reduce repetitive work, generate tests, document code and understand unfamiliar parts of the code base, including during incident investigations. You remain responsible for the design and quality of the resulting work.
• After a full onboarding, take part in a shared, compensated on-call rotation that is mostly remote, helping to ensure system availability and grid stability. Critical incidents are handled with support from the team.
Previous SCIL knowledge is not required. You will receive training and coaching from the team, and the skills you develop can be applied beyond this specific platform.
## 📝 Your profile
• You have relevant experience in an industrial OT environment.
• You are fluent in spoken and written English. This is essential for the role.
• You care about building reliable software and systems.
## 💼 Offer
You will be part of a growing Belgian SME where initiative and personal development are encouraged. We will provide you with an enjoyable work environment with fun colleagues. We will work out a career plan with you, with attention and a budget for extra education/certification. You can count on an attractive salary, supplemented with extra-legal benefits, including a company car.

title: Product Owner, AI Pod
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Product Owner (Contractor) for two AI Pods that build the foundations of Numa, Enumerate’s AI product line, including Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist. This role is focused on execution, not product strategy or roadmap direction. The Product Owner will own and detail the AI Pod backlog, lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for every release, document test findings clearly, and analyze customer usage and metrics to inform what gets built next. The role reports to the Director of Product Management and works closely with Product Managers and Engineering. This is a strong fit for someone with a QA background who has recently moved into a product role and wants to grow in product management working on live, customer-facing AI products.
This is a remote contractor opportunity for candidates located in LATAM who are comfortable working in an English-speaking professional environment.
## Key Responsibilities
## Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution
• Own, detail, and manage the delivery backlog for the two AI Pod teams
• Translate defined product priorities into detailed user stories, functional requirements, and testable acceptance criteria
• Break down initiatives into well-scoped epics, stories, and tasks with clear definitions of ready and done
• Keep backlog items refined, prioritized, and ready for development ahead of each sprint
• Work with other Product Managers and Product Owners whose features depend on the AI Pods to validate requirements and sign-off
• Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives
• Partner with Engineering to clarify scope, remove blockers, and escalate dependencies and risks
User Acceptance Testing & Quality Validation
• Plan and conduct UAT for AI Pod deliverables and provide release sign-off
• Create and maintain UAT plans, test scenarios, and test cases tied to acceptance criteria
• Perform functional, regression, and edge-case testing on completed stories and features before release
• Validate AI output quality for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, including accuracy, relevance, consistency, and exception handling, using repeatable test prompts and evaluation sets
• Log, document, and prioritize defects, and verify fixes before closing
## Documentation of Findings
• Document UAT results, defects, and AI output evaluation findings in a clear, structured, repeatable format
• Produce release-level test summaries covering what was tested, results, known issues, and recommended follow-ups
• Maintain up-to-date user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, and supporting documentation
• Provide Product Marketing with feature details and release information needed for go-to-market materials
## Customer Usage & Metrics Analysis
• Own product analytics for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, including adoption, usage, and engagement metrics
• Analyze usage patterns, customer questions, and feedback to identify friction points, gaps in AI responses, and improvement opportunities
• Build and maintain recurring usage and metrics reporting for product leadership
• Turn findings into backlog items and use data to inform prioritization
## AI & Automation Workflow Enablement
• Analyze and document end-to-end workflows suitable for AI-driven automation
• Turn tasks users currently perform manually into clear requirements Engineering can build from
• Define business rules, inputs, outputs, dependencies, and exception handling
• Ensure workflows are well-documented and testable
## Required Qualifications
• Background in QA or software testing (manual and/or automated), with recent hands-on experience (roughly 1–3 years) as a Product Owner, Associate Product Manager, or Business Analyst on a software product
• Strong UAT experience: writing test plans and test cases from acceptance criteria, executing functional, regression, and edge-case testing, and giving release sign-off
• Experience writing detailed user stories and testable acceptance criteria and managing a backlog in Jira or a similar tool within an Agile/Scrum team
• At least some hands-on experience with AI products, such as working on, testing, or supporting an LLM-powered assistant, chatbot, or AI feature
• Working understanding of LLMs, including why outputs vary, common failure modes such as hallucination and inconsistency, and how to test and evaluate AI output quality
• Analytical by nature: comfortable pulling and interpreting product usage data and turning findings into clear recommendations
• Clear, structured written documentation that others can act on without a walkthrough
• Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken
## Nice to Have
• B2B SaaS experience, ideally vertical SaaS, proptech, or FinTech/Payments
• Experience evaluating conversational AI output in a structured way (prompt test sets, evaluation rubrics, regression testing for AI)
• Experience with product analytics tools (e.g., Pendo, Mixpanel, Amplitude) and basic SQL
• Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones
• Familiarity with property management, HOA/community association, or accounting workflows
## About Us
Enumerate is a leader in the property management space offering a robust ERP system called Central that delivers Community Accounting, Management, Communications, Engagement, and Reporting all on one easy-to-use platform. It is the most comprehensive solution for property management, powerful enough to support large scale Property Managers, yet easy enough for Self-Management Associations.
At Enumerate, we put the Customer First in everything we do, delivering customer-centric solutions and finding ways to say YES. We have an incredible team atmosphere where egos don’t exist, and we credit others for contributions, accomplishments, and success.
